title.zh: 卷十六 本紀第十六: 宣宗下
title.raw: 卷十六 本紀第十六: 宣宗下 Volume 16 Annals 16: Xuanzong 3

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬辰朔，詔免朝。

translations.literal: In spring of the fourth year, on the first day of the first month, renchen new moon, an edict excused court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the first month’s renchen new moon, the court excused officials from morning audience.

sentences.zh: 丙申，金安軍節度使行元帥府事古裏甲古倫除名。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Guli Jagulun, military commissioner of Jin’an Army acting in marshal headquarters affairs, was struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Guli Jagulun, Jin’an Army commissioner acting for the marshalate, was struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大元兵下好義堡，霍州刺史移剌阿裏合等死之。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Great Yuan troops took Haoyi Fort; Huo Prefecture inspector Yila Alihe and others died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Great Yuan forces seized Haoyi Fort; Yila Alihe, inspector of Huo Prefecture, and his party fell in the fight.

sentences.zh: 詔贈官有差。

translations.literal: An edict granted posthumous offices in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: The throne granted posthumous ranks in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，宋步騎十餘萬圍鄧州，聞援軍至，夜焚營去，招撫副使朮虎移剌答追及之，奪其俘還。

translations.literal: On gengxu, more than a hundred thousand Song infantry and cavalry besieged Deng Prefecture; hearing relief had come, they burned camp and left by night. Pacification Vice-Commissioner Tuge Yilada pursued, overtook them, and recovered the captives.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu over a hundred thousand Song foot and horse invested Deng Prefecture. Word of relief reached them and they fired the camp and stole away by night. Pacification vice-commissioner Tuge Yilada ran them down and brought the prisoners back.

sentences.zh: 壬子，晝晦，有頃大雷電，雨以風。

translations.literal: On renzi, the day turned dark at noon; soon great thunder and lightning came, with wind-driven rain.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi noon went dark as night; thunder and lightning followed, and rain drove in on the wind.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，戶部侍郎張師魯上書，請遣騎兵數千，及春，淮、蜀並進、以撓宋。

translations.literal: On guichou, Vice Director of the Revenue Ministry Zhang Shiru submitted a memorial asking that several thousand cavalry be sent, and that when spring came Huai and Shu advance together to harry Song.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Zhang Shiru of the Revenue Ministry asked the throne to send several thousand horsemen and, once spring opened, strike Song from both the Huai and Shu corridors at once.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以武仙遙領中京留守，進官一階。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Wu Xian was made to oversee the Central Capital in absentia and advanced one rank in office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wu Xian was given remote charge of the Central Capital and promoted one grade.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，議遷睢州，治書侍御史蒲魯虎奉詔相視京東城池，還言勿遷便，乃止。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinchou, removal to Suizhou was debated. Investigating Censor Pucha Erlu was ordered to survey cities and walls east of the capital; on his return he said moving would not be advantageous, and the plan stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinchou: the court weighed shifting the seat to Suizhou. Pucha Erlu, investigating censor, toured the eastern strongholds and reported that a move would not pay; the plan died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，長春節，詔免朝。

translations.literal: On guimao, the Long Spring Festival; an edict excused court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Long Spring Festival, the court again excused morning audience.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，林州元帥惟良擒叛人單仲、李俊，誅之，降其党盧廣。

translations.literal: On yisi, Lin Prefecture marshal Weiliang seized the rebels Shan Zhong and Li Jun, executed them, and accepted the surrender of their follower Lu Guang.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Weiliang, marshal at Lin Prefecture, took the rebels Shan Zhong and Li Jun, put them to death, and Lu Guang of their band came in.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以吏部尚書李復亨參知政事，南京兵馬使朮甲賽也行懷、孟帥府事。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Li Fuheng, Director of the Personnel Ministry, was made participation councillor; Nanjing horse-and-troop commissioner Shujia Sai’er was ordered to handle Huai and Meng marshal headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Fuheng, director of the Personnel Ministry, joined the council; Shujia Sai’er, Nanjing horse commissioner, took the Huai and Meng marshal headquarters.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，進平章政事高汝礪為尚書右丞相，監修國史，封壽國公。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Grand Councillor Gao Rulü was advanced to Right Director of the Masters of Writing, overseer of the national history, and enfeoffed Duke of Shou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Gao Rulü rose from grand councillor to right director of the Masters of Writing, overseer of the national history, and duke of Shou.

sentences.zh: 參知政事李復亨兼修國史。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Li Fuheng was also made overseer of the national history.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fuheng, participation councillor, was named co-overseer of the national history.

sentences.zh: 平章政事、陝西行尚書省胥鼎進封溫國公，致仕。

translations.literal: Grand Councillor and Shaanxi Branch Secretariat Xu Ding was advanced to Duke of Wen and retired.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Ding, grand councillor on the Shaanxi branch secretariat, was made duke of Wen and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 壬子，紅襖賊於忙兒襲據海州，經略使完顏陳兒以兵擊敗忙兒，復取之。

translations.literal: On renzi, Red-cloak bandits at Mang’er seized Haizhou; Route Strategist Wanyan Chen’er attacked, defeated Mang’er, and recovered the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Red-cloak rebels held Mang’er and overran Haizhou. Route strategist Wanyan Chen’er marched out, broke Mang’er, and took the city back.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，木星犯鬼宿積屍氣。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Jupiter trespassed on the Ghost mansion’s corpse-gas asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Jupiter crossed the corpse-gas star in the Ghost mansion.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚申朔，詔御史中丞完顏伯嘉提控防城事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengshen new moon: an edict made Censor-in-Chief Wanyan Bojia overseer of wall-defense affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the fourth month’s gengshen new moon, Censor-in-Chief Wanyan Bojia was put in charge of the capital defenses.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，安武軍節度使柴茂破紅襖賊于棗強。

translations.literal: On guihai, Anwu Army Military Commissioner Chai Mao defeated Red-cloak bandits at Zaoqiang.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Chai Mao, commissioner of Anwu Army, routed Red-cloak rebels at Zaoqiang.

sentences.zh: 祁州經略使段增順破叛賊甄全于唐縣。

translations.literal: Qizhou Route Strategist Duan Zengshun defeated the rebel Zhen Quan at Tang County.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Zengshun, strategist on the Qizhou route, crushed the rebel Zhen Quan at Tang County.

sentences.zh: 夏人犯邊，元帥石盞合喜破之。

translations.literal: The Xia raided the border; Marshal Shi Shannuhexi defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Xia forces crossed the border; Marshal Shi Shannuhexi beat them back.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以彰德、衛、輝、滑、浚諸州隸河南路轉運司。

translations.literal: On yichou, Zhangde, Wei, Hui, Hua, and Xun prefectures were placed under the Henan Route transport office.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhangde, Wei, Hui, Hua, and Xun were folded into the Henan transport circuit.

sentences.zh: 以河南路轉運司為都轉運，視中都，增置官吏。

translations.literal: The Henan Route transport office was made supreme transport, on the model of the Central Capital, with added staff.
translations.idiomatic: Henan transport was elevated to supreme transport, modeled on the Central Capital, with a larger staff.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，禘於太廟。

translations.literal: On wuchen, the imperial shrine rite was performed at the Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the court held the imperial shrine service in the Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 大元遣趙瑞以兵攻孟州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan sent Zhao Rui with troops to attack Meng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Yuan sent Zhao Rui to strike Meng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 提控魯德、王安復大名府。

translations.literal: Overseers Lu De and Wang An recovered Daming Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Overseers Lu De and Wang An retook Daming Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 以參知政事把胡魯權尚書右丞、左副元師，元帥左都監承立為右監軍權參知政事，同行尚書省元帥府于京兆。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Ba Hulu was made acting Right Director of the Masters of Writing and left vice marshal; Left Marshal Overseer Chengli was made right army overseer and acting participation councillor, and together they took the branch secretariat and marshal headquarters to Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Ba Hulu, participation councillor, became acting right director of the Masters of Writing and left vice marshal; Chengli, left marshal overseer, became right army overseer and acting participation councillor. Both moved the branch secretariat and marshal headquarters to Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，東平元帥府總領提控蒲察山兒破紅襖賊於聊城。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Dongping Marshal Headquarters Chief Overseer Pucha Shan’er defeated Red-cloak bandits at Liaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Pucha Shan’er, chief overseer under the Dongping marshalate, broke Red-cloak rebels at Liaocheng.

sentences.zh: 壬年，命六部檢法以法狀親白部官，聽其面議，大理寺如之。

translations.literal: On renwu, the Six Ministries’ law-review clerks were ordered to present written rulings in person to their department heads and debate face to face; the Court of Judicial Review was to follow the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu the court required Six Ministries law clerks to read their case summaries aloud to department heads and argue them face to face; the Court of Judicial Review followed suit.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，定二品至三品立功遷官格。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renchen: rules were fixed for promoting officials of second through third rank on merit in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renchen, the court set the merit tables for battlefield promotions from second to third rank.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，紅襖賊寇樂陵、鹽山，橫海軍節度使王福連擊敗之，張聚來寇，又敗之。

translations.literal: On guisi, Red-cloak bandits raided Leling and Yanshan; Henghai Army Military Commissioner Wang Fu defeated them in succession, and when Zhang Ju came to raid, defeated him again.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Red-cloak rebels hit Leling and Yanshan. Wang Fu, commissioner of Henghai Army, beat them off; Zhang Ju raided next and was beaten again.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上擊鞠于臨武殿。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the emperor played cuju in the Hall of Martial Cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the emperor kicked the ball in the Hall of Martial Cultivation.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以時暑，免常朝，四日一奏事。

translations.literal: On bingchen, because of the summer heat, regular court was suspended and memorials were heard every four days.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, with the heat at its height, the throne dropped daily audience and took memorials every fourth day.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，諭工部暑月停工役。

translations.literal: On dingyou, the Works Ministry was told to halt labor corvée in the summer months.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou the Works Ministry was ordered to stop corvée projects through the hot months.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大元兵徇庾州。

translations.literal: On guimao, Great Yuan troops overran Yuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Great Yuan forces swept Yuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，大元兵徇兗州，泰定軍節度使兀顏畏可死之。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Great Yuan troops overran Yan Prefecture; Taiding Army Military Commissioner Wugun Weike died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Great Yuan forces overran Yan Prefecture; Wugun Weike, commissioner of Taiding Army, fell with the city.

sentences.zh: 六月丙寅，遣人招張柔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, bingyin: envoys were sent to summon Zhang Rou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on bingyin, the court sent envoys to call in Zhang Rou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔減監察御史四員。

translations.literal: On dingmao, an edict cut four investigating censor posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict removed four investigating censors.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，山東民僑居者募壯士五百人，益東莒公燕寧軍。

translations.literal: On wuchen, five hundred stalwarts were recruited from Shandong folk living as refugees, augmenting Duke of Dongju Yan Ning’s army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen five hundred stout men were raised from Shandong refugees to reinforce the army of Yan Ning, duke of Dongju.

sentences.zh: 月犯土星。

translations.literal: The moon trespassed on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: The moon crossed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太白晝見於張，百八十有四日乃伏。

translations.literal: On jisi, Venus appeared in daylight in the Zhang mansion and remained visible a hundred and eighty-four days before setting.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Venus shone by day in the Zhang mansion and did not set for a hundred and eighty-four days.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，制諸倉場庫院巡護軍，受提舉倉場司及監支納官彈壓。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, regulations were made for patrol guards at granaries, depots, and storehouses, subject to pressure from the Granary Overseer’s office and the receiving officers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the court regulated patrol guards at every granary, depot, and storehouse, placing them under the granary overseer and the receiving officers.

sentences.zh: 京畿不雨，敕有司閱獄，雜犯死罪以下皆釋之。

translations.literal: The capital region had no rain; the throne ordered a prison review, and all mixed offenses below death were released.
translations.idiomatic: With no rain around the capital, the throne ordered the jails reviewed and every mixed offense short of death was freed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，大元遣楊在攻下大名，又攻開州及東明、長垣等縣。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Great Yuan sent Yang Zai to take Daming and then attack Kai Prefecture and the counties of Dongming, Changyuan, and others.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Yang Zai of the Great Yuan seized Daming and pressed Kai Prefecture and Dongming, Changyuan, and neighboring counties.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祈雨。

translations.literal: On jimao, rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宋人方子忻來歸，有司處之鄭州。

translations.literal: On gengchen, the Song man Fang Zixin came over; the authorities placed him at Zheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Fang Zixin, a man of Song, defected and was lodged at Zheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「吾民奔宋者，彼例衣食之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "When our people flee to Song, they are routinely fed and clothed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "When our people run to Song, Song feeds and clothes them as a rule.

sentences.zh: 彼來歸者，不善視之，或復逃歸，漏泄機事。

translations.literal: When theirs come to us, we do not treat them well; some flee back again and leak our plans.
translations.idiomatic: When theirs come to us we treat them poorly, and some slip back and betray our plans.

sentences.zh: 」命增子忻廩給，有司優遇之。

translations.literal: " He ordered Zixin’s grain stipend increased and the offices to show him favor.
translations.idiomatic: " He raised Zixin’s grain allowance and told the offices to treat defectors generously.

sentences.zh: 元帥右監軍、權參知政事承立上封事。

translations.literal: Right army overseer and acting participation councillor Chengli submitted a sealed memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Chengli, right army overseer and acting participation councillor, sent up a sealed memorial.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛卯，宋人及紅襖賊犯河朔，諸郡皆降，獨滄州經略使王福固守。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinmao: Song troops and Red Coat bandits invaded Hebei; every commandery submitted except Cangzhou Pacification Commissioner Wang Fu, who held firm.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the seventh month's xinmao, Song forces and Red Coat bandits overran Hebei; every commandery yielded except Cangzhou Pacification Commissioner Wang Fu, who held out.

sentences.zh: 會益都賊張林來攻，福乃叛降林，帥府請討之。

translations.literal: When Yidu bandit Zhang Lin came to attack, Fu then rebelled and submitted to Lin; the marshalate asked permission to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yidu rebel Zhang Lin attacked, Fu turned traitor and surrendered to Lin; the marshalate sought leave to strike him.

sentences.zh: 是日，雨。

translations.literal: That day it rained.
translations.idiomatic: That day it rained.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，林州行元帥府遣總領嚴祿等討紅襖賊於彰德府，生擒偽安撫使王九。

translations.literal: On guichou the Linzhou traveling marshalate sent Chief Controller Yan Lu and others to campaign against Red Coat bandits at Zhangde prefecture and took the false pacification commissioner Wang Jiu alive.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the Linzhou traveling marshalate sent Chief Controller Yan Lu and others against Red Coat bandits at Zhangde and captured the false pacification commissioner Wang Jiu alive.

sentences.zh: 詔參知政事李復亨為慰使，御史丞完顏伯嘉副之，循行郡縣勸農。

translations.literal: An edict made Participation Councillor Li Fuheng consolation commissioner, with Censorate Vice Director Wanyan Bojia as his deputy, to tour the commanderies and encourage agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Participation Councillor Li Fuheng consolation commissioner, with Censorate Vice Director Wanyan Bojia as deputy, to tour the commanderies and promote farming.

sentences.zh: 以烏古論仲端等使大元。

translations.literal: Wugulun Zhongduan and others were sent as envoys to Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Wugulun Zhongduan and others were dispatched as envoys to Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 八月戊午朔，嚴實、成江、王贇據濟南，山東招撫高居實遣人招嚴實於青崖砦，獲其款以聞。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuwu new moon: Yan Shi, Cheng Jiang, and Wang Yun held Jinan; Shandong Pacification Commissioner Gao Jushi sent men to win Yan Shi's pledge at Qingya Fortress and reported his submission.
translations.idiomatic: On the eighth month's wuwu new moon Yan Shi, Cheng Jiang, and Wang Yun held Jinan; Shandong Pacification Commissioner Gao Jushi sent envoys to win Yan Shi's submission at Qingya Fortress and reported it upward.

sentences.zh: 李全犯東平府，監軍王庭玉敗之，擒其偽安化軍節度使張林。

translations.literal: Li Quan attacked Dongping prefecture; Supervisory Commissioner Wang Tingyu defeated him and captured his false Anhua Army commissioner Zhang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: Li Quan attacked Dongping; Supervisory Commissioner Wang Tingyu routed him and seized his false Anhua Army commissioner Zhang Lin.

sentences.zh: 庚申，高陽公張甫請增兵守冀州。

translations.literal: On gengshen Gaoyang Duke Zhang Pu asked that more troops be sent to hold Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Gaoyang Duke Zhang Pu asked for reinforcements to defend Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 上諭樞密，潁州民渡淮為宋軍者凡十村，可追索主者，懲一二以試其餘。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the Bureau of Military Affairs that in Yingzhou ten villages of people who had crossed the Huai to join Song armies could be traced to their headmen; punish one or two to test the rest.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Bureau of Military Affairs that ten Yingzhou villages whose people had crossed the Huai to serve Song could be traced to their headmen—punish one or two as a warning to the rest.

sentences.zh: 庚午，敕掌兵官不聽舉縣令。

translations.literal: On gengwu an edict forbade officers who held military posts from recommending magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu an edict barred commanders from nominating county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 夏人陷會州，刺史烏古論世顯降。

translations.literal: Xia forces took Huizhou; Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Xia took Huizhou and Prefect Wugulun Shixian surrendered.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，陝西行省報龕谷敗夏人之捷。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported the victory over Xia at Qian Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat reported victory over Xia at Qian Valley.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上諭宰臣，河南水災，唐、鄧尤甚。

translations.literal: On yihai the emperor told the chief ministers that Henan had suffered floods, Tang and Deng especially.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the emperor told the chief ministers that Henan had been flooded, Tang and Deng worst of all.

sentences.zh: 其被災州縣，已除其租。

translations.literal: In the disaster counties and districts rent had already been remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Rent had already been remitted in the stricken counties and districts.

sentences.zh: 余順成之方，止責正供，和糴、雜征並免。

translations.literal: In the remaining districts where conditions were normal, only the regular quota was to be collected; harmonized purchases and miscellaneous levies were all waived.
translations.idiomatic: Elsewhere, where conditions were normal, only the regular quota was to be collected; harmonized purchases and miscellaneous levies were all waived.

sentences.zh: 仍自今歲九月始，停周歲桑皮故紙折輸。

translations.literal: From this year's ninth month onward the annual mulberry-bark and scrap-paper surcharge was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: From the ninth month of this year the annual mulberry-bark and scrap-paper surcharge was stopped.

sentences.zh: 流民佃荒田者如上優免。

translations.literal: Refugees who farmed wasteland were given the same exemptions as above.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees who farmed wasteland received the same exemptions.

sentences.zh: 丙子，陝西行省與夏人議和。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat negotiated peace with the Xia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat negotiated peace with Xia.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，定選補親軍法。

translations.literal: On wuyin regulations were fixed for selecting and filling personal-guard posts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the law for selecting and filling personal-guard posts was fixed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，罷葭州招撫司。

translations.literal: On jimao the Jiazhou Pacification Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the Jiazhou Pacification Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬午，陝西路行省承裔報定西州之捷。

translations.literal: On renwu the Shaanxi Route Branch Secretariat Chengyi reported victory at Dingxi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Shaanxi Route Branch Secretariat Chengyi reported victory at Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以隨路諸軍戶徙河南、京東、西、南路，各設檢察使、副。

translations.literal: On bingxu inspectors and deputies were established for army households moved to Henan and the eastern, western, and southern capital routes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu inspectors and deputies were set up for army households resettled in Henan and on the eastern, western, and southern capital routes.

sentences.zh: 恆山公武仙降大元。

translations.literal: Hengshan Duke Wu Xian surrendered to Great Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Hengshan Duke Wu Xian defected to Great Yuan.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，詔遣官于河南、陝西選親軍。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuzi: an edict sent officials to Henan and Shaanxi to select personal guards.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi, an edict sent officials to Henan and Shaanxi to select personal guards.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，進《章宗實錄》。

translations.literal: On xinmao the Veritable Records of Zhangzong were presented.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the Veritable Records of Zhangzong were presented.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，大元木華里屯軍真定。

translations.literal: On wuxu Great Yuan's Mukhali encamped at Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Great Yuan's Mukhali encamped at Zhending.

sentences.zh: 置總領元帥府于歸德，以壽州、陳留兩鎮兵屬之。

translations.literal: A chief controller marshalate was set up at Guide, with the Shouzhou and Chenliu garrison troops placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: A chief-controller marshalate was established at Guide, with Shouzhou and Chenliu garrison troops assigned to it.

sentences.zh: 庚子，夏人入定西州。

translations.literal: On gengzi Xia forces entered Dingxi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Xia entered Dingxi prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宋人屯皁郊堡，行軍提控完顏益都擊敗之。

translations.literal: On renyin Song troops encamped at Zaojiao Fortress; Traveling Army Control Officer Wanyan Yidu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Song encamped at Zaojiao Fortress; Traveling Army Control Officer Wanyan Yidu routed them.

sentences.zh: 大元遣塔忽等來。

translations.literal: Great Yuan sent Tahu and others.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan sent Tahu and others.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，夏人來侵。

translations.literal: On guimao Xia came to raid.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Xia raided.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，滕州招捕提控夏義勇討紅襖賊，敗之。

translations.literal: On jiachen Tengzhou Pacification and Capture Control Officer Xia Yiyong campaigned against Red Coat bandits and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Tengzhou Pacification and Capture Control Officer Xia Yiyong fought Red Coat bandits and beat them.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔參知政事李復亨提控芻糧事。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict made Participation Councillor Li Fuheng control officer for fodder and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi an edict made Participation Councillor Li Fuheng control officer over fodder and grain.

sentences.zh: 己酉，夏人陷西寧州，尚書省都事僕散奴失不坐誅，駙馬都尉徒單壽春奪官一階，杖六十。

translations.literal: On jiyou Xia took Xining prefecture; Masters of Writing Bureau Director Pusan Nushibu was sentenced to death, and Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Tusan Shouchun was demoted one rank and beaten sixty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Xia took Xining; Masters of Writing Bureau Director Pusan Nushibu was condemned to death, and Imperial Son-in-Law Commandant Tusan Shouchun lost one rank and took sixty strokes.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，更定安泊逃亡出征軍人罪及捕獲賞格。

translations.literal: On guichou penalties and capture rewards were revised for soldiers who deserted from campaign lodgings.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou penalties and capture bounties were revised for soldiers who deserted from campaign lodgings.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宋人出秦州，及夏人來侵。

translations.literal: On jiayin Song came out from Qinzhou and Xia also came to raid.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Song advanced from Qinzhou and Xia raided as well.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，鞏州行元帥府石盞合喜報定西州之捷。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Gongzhou traveling marshalate's Shizhan Hexi reported victory at Dingxi prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Gongzhou traveling marshalate Shizhan Hexi reported victory at Dingxi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬戌，大元遣蒙古塔忽、訛裏剌等來。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, renxu: Great Yuan sent Mongol Tahu, Bolir, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on the tenth month's renxu, Great Yuan sent Mongol Tahu, Bolir, and others.

sentences.zh: 己卯，陝西東路行省報綏德州之捷。

translations.literal: On jimao the Eastern Shaanxi Route Branch Secretariat reported victory at Suide prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Eastern Shaanxi Route reported victory at Suide.

sentences.zh: 泗州元帥府言，紅襖賊一月四入寇，掠人畜而去。

translations.literal: The Sizhou marshalate reported that Red Coat bandits had raided four times in one month, carrying off people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The Sizhou marshalate said Red Coat bandits had raided four times in one month, seizing people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上擊鞠于臨武殿。

translations.literal: On gengchen the emperor played cuju at Linwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the emperor played cuju at Linwu Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，授紅襖賊時青滕陽公、本處兵馬總領、元帥兼宣撫。

translations.literal: On xinsi Red Coat bandit Shi Qing was made Duke of Tengyang, local commander-in-chief, and marshal with concurrent pacification powers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Red Coat bandit Shi Qing was made Duke of Tengyang, local commander-in-chief, and marshal with concurrent pacification authority.

sentences.zh: 癸未，京西山寨各設守禦使、副，令本路府總之。

translations.literal: On guimao defensive commissioners and deputies were set up for each stockade of the western capital mountain forts, with the route prefectures in overall charge.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao each western-capital mountain stockade gained a defensive commissioner and deputy, under the route prefectures' overall command.

sentences.zh: 諭陝西行省圖復會州。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi Route was instructed to recover Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Route was told to recover Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 上擊鞠于臨武殿。

translations.literal: The emperor played cuju at Linwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor played cuju at Linwu Hall.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥朔，免越王永功朔望朝參。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dinghai new moon: Prince of Yue Yonggong was excused from the first- and fifteenth-day audiences.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh month's dinghai new moon Prince of Yue Yonggong was excused from first- and fifteenth-day audiences.

sentences.zh: 易水公靖安民為其下所殺。

translations.literal: Yishui Duke Jing Anmin was killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Yishui Duke Jing Anmin was killed by his own men.

sentences.zh: 戊子，黃陵堈經略使烏古論石虎等以戰陣失律，伏誅。

translations.literal: On wuzi Huanglinggang Pacification Commissioner Wugulun Shihu and others were executed for battlefield misconduct.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Huanglinggang Pacification Commissioner Wugulun Shihu and others were put to death for battlefield misconduct.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，木星晝見於翼，積六十有七日伏，夜又犯靈臺北第一星。

translations.literal: On renchen Jupiter was visible by day in Yi; after sixty-seven days it set, and at night it again trespassed the first star north of the Spirit Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Jupiter shone by day in Yi; after sixty-seven days it set, and that night it again trespassed the first star north of the Spirit Terrace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，河南水，遣官勸課。

translations.literal: On jiawu Henan suffered flooding; officials were dispatched to encourage agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu floods struck Henan; the court sent officials to urge farming.

sentences.zh: 更浮山縣名忠孝。

translations.literal: Fushan County was renamed Zhongxiao.
translations.idiomatic: Fushan County was renamed Zhongxiao.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔復衛紹王王爵，仍加開府議同三司。

translations.literal: On wuxu an edict restored Prince Shao of Wei's princely rank and additionally made him palace-gate grand master with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the throne restored Prince Shao of Wei's title and added palace-gate grand master with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，山東東路軍戶徙許州，命行東平總管府治之，判官一人分司臨潁。

translations.literal: On renyin military households of Shandong East Circuit were moved to Xu Prefecture; the traveling Dongping chief commandant's office was ordered to govern them, with one aide commissioner administering affairs at Linying.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Shandong East military households were shifted to Xu Prefecture under the traveling Dongping chief commandant, with one aide commissioner stationed at Linying.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔柴茂權元帥左都監，蓋仁貴攝右都監，同行元帥府于真定。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict made Chai Mao acting marshalate left overseer and Gai Rengui acting right overseer; both were to travel with the marshalate headquarters at Zhending.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Chai Mao was named acting left marshal overseer and Gai Rengui acting right overseer, both moving the marshalate headquarters to Zhending.

sentences.zh: 是月，大元木華里國王以兵圍東平。

translations.literal: That month Great Yuan King Muqali invested Dongping with troops.
translations.idiomatic: That month Great Yuan King Muqali besieged Dongping.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，祈雪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu: prayers for snow.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiaxu, the court prayed for snow.

sentences.zh: 禮部郎中權左司諫抹撚胡魯剌上封事。

translations.literal: Ministry of Rites section chief and acting Left Remonstrance Office censor Mo'emun Hulu-la submitted a sealed memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Mo'emun Hulu-la, section chief in the Ministry of Rites and acting left remonstrance censor, sent up a sealed memorial.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔軍官許月擊鞠者三次，以習武事。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict permitted military officers to play cuju three times a month to practice martial affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict let military officers play cuju three times a month to keep up martial training.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，獵，享於太廟。

translations.literal: On gengchen he hunted and offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he hunted and made offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鎮南軍節度使溫蒂罕思敬上書言錢幣、稅賦二事。

translations.literal: On yiyou Wendihan Sijing, military commissioner of the Pacify-the-South Army, submitted a memorial on currency and tax levies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Wendihan Sijing, commissioner of the Pacify-the-South Army, memorialized on coinage and taxation.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丙戌朔，免朝。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, bingxu new moon: court audience was waived.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the first month's bingxu new moon, morning audience was excused.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，世宗忌日，謁奠于啟慶宮。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Shizong's death anniversary, libation was offered at Qiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Shizong's death anniversary, the court offered libation at Qiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，括南京諸州逋戶舊耕官田，給軍戶。

translations.literal: On wuzi delinquent households in the Southern Capital's prefectures who had formerly farmed state land were registered and assigned to military households.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi delinquent tenants in Nanjing prefectures who had once worked state fields were tallied and turned into military households.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，議禦西夏及征南事。

translations.literal: On renchen the court deliberated on defending against Western Xia and the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the court debated defense against Western Xia and the southern expedition.

sentences.zh: 諭皇太子以東平禦敵方略。

translations.literal: The crown prince was instructed on strategies for defending Dongping against the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince was briefed on how to hold Dongping against the enemy.

sentences.zh: 甲午，諭樞密院，南伐事重，當詳議其便。

translations.literal: On jiawu the Secretariat was told that the southern expedition was weighty and its advantages should be weighed in detail.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the throne told the Secretariat the southern war was grave and every advantage had to be weighed carefully.

sentences.zh: 撰故衛王事蹟，如海陵庶人例。

translations.literal: A record of the late Prince of Wei's career was compiled, following the precedent used for Hailing the Deposed Person.
translations.idiomatic: A narrative of the late Prince of Wei's deeds was compiled on the model used for Hailing the deposed emperor.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，大元兵攻天井關。

translations.literal: On dingyou Great Yuan forces attacked Tianjing Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Great Yuan troops struck Tianjing Pass.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，宋人襲泗州西城，提控王祿死之。

translations.literal: On wuxu Song forces raided the western quarter of Sizhou; Controller Wang Lu died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Song raided Sizhou's west wall; Controller Wang Lu was killed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，太白晝見於牛，二百三十有二日伏。

translations.literal: On xinchou Venus appeared in daytime in the Ox mansion and set after two hundred thirty-two days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Venus shone by day in the Ox mansion and did not set for two hundred thirty-two days.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔諸道兵集蔡州，己酉，伐宋。

translations.literal: On yisi an edict ordered troops of all circuits to assemble at Cai Prefecture; on jiyou they attacked Song.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the throne ordered every circuit's troops to Cai Prefecture; on jiyou they marched on Song.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，山東行省報東平之捷。

translations.literal: On gengxu Shandong Traveling Secretariat reported victory at Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the Shandong traveling secretariat reported victory at Dongping.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰朔，置招撫司于單州。

translations.literal: Second month, bingchen new moon: a Pacification Commission was established at Shan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the bingchen new moon, a pacification commission was set up at Shan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 曲赦東平府。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to Dongping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dongping Prefecture received a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 庚申，下詔伐宋。

translations.literal: On gengshen an edict declared war on Song.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict opened war on Song.

sentences.zh: 以內族惟弼權同簽樞密院事，行院於中京；

translations.literal: The imperial clansman Wei Bi was made acting co-signer of the Secretariat and given a traveling secretariat at the Central Capital;
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansman Wei Bi was named acting Secretariat co-signer with a traveling secretariat at the Central Capital;

sentences.zh: 斡勒合打權元帥府右都監，行元帥府于蔡、息；

translations.literal: Wolai Heda was acting marshalate right overseer with headquarters at Cai and Xi;
translations.idiomatic: Wolai Heda became acting right marshal overseer with headquarters at Cai and Xi;

sentences.zh: 納合降福權簽樞密院事，行院於宿州；

translations.literal: Nahe Jiangfu was acting Secretariat signer with headquarters at Su Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Nahe Jiangfu was acting Secretariat signer with headquarters at Su Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 孛朮魯達阿權元帥右都監，完顏訛論副右都監，行元帥府于唐、鄧。

translations.literal: Bozhuluda'a was acting marshal right overseer, Wanyan Elun deputy right overseer, with headquarters at Tang and Deng.
translations.idiomatic: Bozhuluda'a was acting right marshal overseer and Wanyan Elun his deputy, with headquarters at Tang and Deng.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，罷懷州行元帥府，復置招撫司，與孟州經略司並受中京行樞密院節制。

translations.literal: On wuchen the traveling marshalate at Huai Prefecture was abolished, the Pacification Commission restored, and both it and the Meng Prefecture pacification commission were placed under the Central Capital traveling Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Huai's traveling marshalate was abolished, its pacification commission restored, and both it and Meng's pacification office were put under the Central Capital traveling Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛未，僕散安貞以元帥出息州，破宋人乾淨居山寺，拔黃土關。

translations.literal: On xinwei Pusan Anzhen led the marshalate out from Xi Prefecture, defeated Song forces at Qianjingju Mountain Temple, and took Huangtu Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Pusan Anzhen marched from Xi Prefecture, broke Song at Qianjingju Mountain Temple, and seized Huangtu Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以旱災，曲赦河南路。

translations.literal: On guiyou, because of drought disaster, Henan Circuit received a partial amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou drought brought a partial amnesty to Henan Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丙子，禁京城兵器。

translations.literal: On bingzi weapons were forbidden in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the capital forbade private arms.

sentences.zh: 元帥紇石烈牙葉塔破宋兵，復泗州。

translations.literal: Marshal He'eshilie Yayeta defeated Song troops and recovered Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal He'eshilie Yayeta routed Song and retook Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 進逼濠州，至渦口，乏糧而還西城。

translations.literal: Advancing on Haozhou as far as Wokou, he returned to the western quarter for lack of provisions.
translations.idiomatic: He pressed Haozhou to Wokou, then fell back to the west wall short of grain.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以旱災，詔中外。

translations.literal: On guiwei, because of drought, an edict was issued throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei drought prompted an edict to the whole realm.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，上御仁安殿，祈雨，仍望祭於北郊。

translations.literal: Third month, bingxu new moon: the emperor took the hall at Ren'an, prayed for rain, and performed a distant offering rite at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the bingxu new moon, the emperor sat in Ren'an Hall, prayed for rain, and offered at a distance in the Northern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宋人圍唐、鄧，行元帥府事完顏訛論力戰卻之。

translations.literal: On gengyin Song forces besieged Tang and Deng; Acting Marshalate Commissioner Wanyan Elun fought hard and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Song invested Tang and Deng; acting marshal commissioner Wanyan Elun fought them off.

sentences.zh: 前鄧州千戶孛朮魯毛良虎自拔歸國，訛論便宜遷其官三階，授同知唐州事，乞正授以示信，從之。

translations.literal: Former Deng Prefecture chiliarch Bozhulu Maolianghu broke out and returned to allegiance; Elun by provisional authority promoted him three ranks and appointed him Assistant Administrator of Tang Prefecture; he asked for formal appointment to show sincerity, and it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Former Deng chiliarch Bozhulu Maolianghu broke free and came back; Elun promoted him three ranks on expedient authority and named him assistant administrator of Tang, then granted his request for a regular commission to prove good faith.

sentences.zh: 乙未，罷河南路行三司。

translations.literal: On yiwei the Henan Circuit traveling Three Offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Henan Circuit's traveling Three Offices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙申，參知政事徒單思忠進尚書右丞、兼修國史，以太子詹事僕散毅夫為參知政事。

translations.literal: On bingchen Participation Councillor Tushan Sizhong was promoted to Vice Director of the Masters of Writing and concurrent National Historian; Crown Prince Household Steward Pusan Yifu was made Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Tushan Sizhong rose from participation councillor to right director of the Masters of Writing and national historian; crown prince steward Pusan Yifu joined the council.

sentences.zh: 諭宰臣曰：「今奉御、奉職多不留心採訪外事。

translations.literal: He told the chief ministers: "Today's palace attendants and service officers mostly do not devote themselves to gathering intelligence on outside affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He told the chief ministers, "Palace attendants and service officers today rarely trouble themselves to gather news from outside.

sentences.zh: 聞章宗時近侍人秩滿，以所采事定升降。

translations.literal: I hear that in Zhangzong's time, when personal attendants finished their term, promotion and demotion were decided by what they had gathered.
translations.idiomatic: I hear that under Zhangzong, when a personal attendant finished his term, what he had learned decided whether he rose or fell.

sentences.zh: 今亦宜預為考核之法，以激勸之。

translations.literal: Now we should likewise prepare methods of appraisal in advance to encourage them."
translations.idiomatic: We ought to set appraisal rules in advance to stir them to it."

sentences.zh: 」戊戌，長春節，免朝。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Long Spring Festival, court audience was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Long Spring Festival, morning audience was excused.

sentences.zh: 己亥，夏因叛人竇趙兒之招，入據來羌城，孛朮魯合住以重賞誘脅從人為內應，督兵急攻城，拔之。

translations.literal: On jihai Xia forces, summoned by the rebel Dou Zhao'er, seized Laiguang City; Bozhulu Hezhu used heavy rewards to induce collaborators within and pressed the assault until the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Xia, answering the rebel Dou Zhao'er, seized Laiguang; Bozhulu Hezhu bought insiders with rich rewards and stormed the place until it fell.

sentences.zh: 省試經義進士，考官于常額外多放喬松等十餘人。

translations.literal: In the provincial examination for policy-essay jinshi, examiners passed more than ten men beyond the quota, including Qiao Song.
translations.idiomatic: At the provincial policy-essay jinshi examination the graders passed more than ten men over quota, among them Qiao Song.

sentences.zh: 有司奏請駁放，上已允，尋復遣諭松等曰：「汝等中選而復黜，不能無動於心。

translations.literal: The relevant offices memorialized to reject the extra passes; the emperor had agreed, but soon sent word to Song and the others: "Having been selected and then dismissed, you cannot help but be troubled in spirit.
translations.idiomatic: The offices asked to strike the extra passes; the emperor had agreed, then sent Qiao Song and the rest word: "Chosen and then cast aside, you cannot be unmoved.

sentences.zh: 方今久旱，恐傷和氣，今特恩放汝矣。

translations.literal: With prolonged drought now, I fear harming harmonious qi; by special grace you are passed."
translations.idiomatic: Long drought now may sour the realm's harmony; by special grace you keep your passes."

sentences.zh: 」庚子，賜林州行元帥府經歷官康琚進士及第。

translations.literal: " On gengzi Kang Ju, registrar of the Linzhou traveling marshalate headquarters, was granted jinshi pass rank.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengzi Kang Ju, registrar at the Linzhou traveling marshalate, was granted jinshi.

sentences.zh: 琚以武階乞赴廷試，故有是命。

translations.literal: Ju had held a military rank and requested to sit for the palace examination — hence this order.
translations.idiomatic: Because Ju had held a military rank and asked to take the palace examination, this order was issued.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以旱築壇祀雷雨師。

translations.literal: On bingwu, because of drought, an altar was built to sacrifice to the Thunder-Rain Master.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, with drought continuing, an altar was erected to sacrifice to the Thunder-Rain Master.

sentences.zh: 壬子，雨。

translations.literal: On renzi it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi it rained.

sentences.zh: 四月己未，山東行省蒙古綱言：「東莒公燕寧戰敗而死。

translations.literal: Fourth month, jiwei: Shandong Traveling Secretariat Mongol Gang reported: "Duke of Eastern Ju Yan Ning was defeated and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiwei, Shandong Traveling Secretariat Mongol Gang reported, "Duke of Eastern Ju Yan Ning was defeated and killed.

sentences.zh: 甯所居天勝砦據險，寧亡，眾無所歸，變在朝夕。

translations.literal: The Tian Sheng stockade where Ning had resided held difficult terrain; with Ning dead the masses had nowhere to turn, and unrest was imminent.
translations.idiomatic: Ning's Tian Sheng stockade lay in rugged country; with him dead the people had nowhere to go, and trouble could break out any day.

sentences.zh: 權署其提控孫邦佐為招撫使，黃摑兀也為總領，以撫其眾。

translations.literal: They provisionally appointed his Control Commissioner Sun Bangzuo Pacification Commissioner and Huang Ga Wuye overall chief to pacify the masses."
translations.idiomatic: They provisionally made his Control Commissioner Sun Bangzuo Pacification Commissioner and Huang Ga Wuye overall chief to settle the people."

sentences.zh: 」遣使請命，敕有司議之。

translations.literal: An envoy was sent to request orders; an edict ordered the responsible offices to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: An envoy was sent to seek instructions; an edict told the responsible offices to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禱雨於太廟。

translations.literal: On xinyou rain was prayed for at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court prayed for rain at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，僕散安貞破宋黃、蘄等州。

translations.literal: On bingyin Pusan Anzhen captured Song's Huang, Qi, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Pusan Anzhen took Song's Huang, Qi, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬申，俘宋宗室男女七十餘口獻于京師。

translations.literal: On renshen more than seventy male and female members of Song's imperial clan were captured and presented at the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen more than seventy men and women of Song's imperial house were taken captive and sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔親軍中武舉第而授職需次者，仍執舊役，廩給循常，闕至發遣。

translations.literal: On guiyou an edict ordered that among the personal guard, those who had passed the military examination and received appointments on a waiting list were still to perform their old duties, rations as usual, and be sent forth when a vacancy opened.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou an edict ruled that personal guards who had passed the military examination but awaited appointment should keep their old duties and usual rations until a post opened.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，監察御史劉從益以彈劾失當，奪官一階，罷之。

translations.literal: On xinsi Supervising Censor Liu Congyi, for improper impeachment, was stripped one rank and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Supervising Censor Liu Congyi, for a faulty impeachment, lost one rank and was removed.

sentences.zh: 詔定進士中下甲及監官散階至明威者舉充縣令法。

translations.literal: An edict fixed the law for nominating lower-middle jinshi grades and supervisory officials with scattered ranks up to Mingwei to serve as county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: An edict set rules for appointing lower-middle jinshi and supervisory officials with scattered ranks up to Mingwei as county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 五月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiashen new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the jiashen new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，宋人據楚丘，官軍復之。

translations.literal: On wuxu Song held Qiuqiu; government troops recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Song seized Qiuqiu; government forces retook it.

sentences.zh: 庚子，納蘭記僧伏誅，告人趙銳升職四等。

translations.literal: On gengzi Nalan Jiseng was executed; the informer Zhao Rui was promoted four grades.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Nalan Jiseng was put to death; the accuser Zhao Rui was raised four ranks.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，陝西元帥完顏賽不遣使來獻晉安、平陽之捷，方議其賞，御史烏古論胡魯劾其縱將士鹵掠，不副主上除亂救民之意，乞正其罪。

translations.literal: On renyin Shaanxi Marshal Wanyan Saibu sent envoys reporting victory at Jin'an and Pingyang; while rewards were under discussion, Censor Wugulun Hulu impeached him for allowing troops to loot, contrary to the sovereign's intent to pacify disorder and aid the people, and asked that his crime be corrected.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Shaanxi Marshal Wanyan Saibu sent word of victories at Jin'an and Pingyang; as rewards were debated, Censor Wugulun Hulu charged him with letting troops plunder, against the emperor's aim to end chaos and help the people, and asked that he be punished.

sentences.zh: 上以賽不有功，詔勿問，賞議亦寢。

translations.literal: The emperor, considering Saibu had merit, ordered no inquiry; the reward discussion also lapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, noting Saibu's merit, ordered no investigation, and the reward proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，唐州守將訛論為元帥賽不猶子，與宋人戰唐州境上，為宋人所敗，死者七百餘人，匿之而以捷聞。

translations.literal: On guimao Tangzhou defender Wanyan Elun, Saibu's nephew, fought Song on the Tangzhou border, was defeated with more than seven hundred dead, concealed it, and reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tangzhou defender Wanyan Elun, Saibu's nephew, fought Song on the Tangzhou frontier, lost with more than seven hundred killed, hid the loss, and reported a victory.

sentences.zh: 御史納蘭發其事。

translations.literal: Censor Nalan exposed the affair.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Nalan brought the matter to light.

sentences.zh: 上以賽不故，亦不之罪，而以是意諭之。

translations.literal: Because of Saibu the emperor again imposed no punishment, but conveyed this intent to him.
translations.idiomatic: Again for Saibu's sake the emperor imposed no penalty, but sent him this understanding.

sentences.zh: 乃稱納蘭敢言，錄其功付有司，秩滿考最。

translations.literal: He then praised Nalan for daring to speak, registered his merit with the responsible offices, and ordered evaluation at term's end.
translations.idiomatic: He then praised Nalan's candor, recorded his merit with the offices, and ordered a full-term review.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，東平內徙，命蒙古綱行省於邳州，王庭玉行帥府于黃陵堈。

translations.literal: On guichou Dongping was moved inward; Mongol Gang was ordered to run the secretariat at Pizhou and Wang Tingyu the marshal headquarters at Huanglinggang.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Dongping was shifted inland; Mongol Gang was sent to run the secretariat at Pizhou and Wang Tingyu the marshal headquarters at Huanglinggang.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子朔，罷黃陵堈招撫司。

translations.literal: Eighth month, renzi new moon: the Huanglinggang Pacification Office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the renzi new moon, the Huanglinggang Pacification Office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 上諭尚書省，碭山叛軍家屬囚歸德，旬餘不給糧，恐傷其生。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed the Secretariat that dependents of Dangshan rebels imprisoned at Guide had gone more than ten days without grain, which might harm their lives.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the Secretariat that kin of Dangshan rebels held at Guide had lacked grain for over ten days, risking their lives.

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏，已給之矣。

translations.literal: The chief ministers reported they had already been supplied.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers replied that rations had already been issued.

sentences.zh: 又諭樞密，河北艱食，民欲南來者日益多，速令渡之，毋致殍死。

translations.literal: He further instructed the Privy Council that with food scarce in Hebei, people wishing to come south were daily increasing; they were to be ferried quickly lest they starve to death.
translations.idiomatic: He also told the Privy Council that with Hebei short of food, ever more people wanted to move south and must be ferried at once so they would not starve.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，林、懷帥府邀擊紅襖賊於伏恩村，敗之。

translations.literal: On guihai the Lin and Huai marshal headquarters intercepted Red-Robe bandits at Fu'en Village and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Lin and Huai marshal headquarters ambushed Red-Robe bandits at Fu'en Village and routed them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔南征潰軍復歸而能力戰者，依出界立功格賞之。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict ordered that southern-campaign troops who returned from rout yet could fight were to be rewarded by the out-of-bounds merit standard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict ruled that routed southern-campaign troops who returned able to fight would be rewarded under the frontier-merit scale.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，宋人掠沈丘，殺縣令。

translations.literal: On yichou Song raided Shenqiu and killed the county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Song raided Shenqiu and killed the county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命有司除逋戶負租，毋征見戶。

translations.literal: On jiaxu offices were ordered to remit rent owed by absent households and not to levy present ones.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu offices were told to cancel arrears of absent households and not tax those still on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，以京東歲饑多盜，遣御史大夫紇石烈胡失門為宣慰使，往撫安之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiashen: with famine-year bandits many in Jingdong, Censor-in-Chief Hesheli Husimen was sent as Pacification Commissioner to soothe and settle the region.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiashen, with Jingdong hungry and bandits numerous, Censor-in-Chief Hesheli Husimen was sent as Pacification Commissioner to calm the circuit.

sentences.zh: 更定監察御史違犯的決法。

translations.literal: Regulations on penalties for supervising censors' violations were revised.
translations.idiomatic: Rules on punishment for supervising censors' infractions were revised.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔州府及軍官捕盜慢職，四品以下宣慰使決之，三品以下上奏裁。

translations.literal: On dinghai an edict ordered that for slack duty in bandit-catching by prefectures and military officers, ranks fourth and below were decided by the Pacification Commissioner and third and below submitted to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai an edict ruled that when prefectures or military officers were slow to catch bandits, cases for the fourth rank and below went to the Pacification Commissioner and third rank and below to the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊子，增授隰州招撫使軒成官，改受陝西省節制。

translations.literal: On wuzi the appointment of Xizhou Pacification Commissioner Xuan Cheng was enhanced, and he was placed under Shaanxi province control.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Xizhou Pacification Commissioner Xuan Cheng received an enhanced appointment and was put under Shaanxi province.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，崇進、駙馬都尉定國公徒單公弼薨。

translations.literal: On yisi Chongjin, Chief Commandant of Escort, Duke of Dingguo Tushan Gongbi died.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Chongjin, Chief Commandant of Escort, Duke of Dingguo Tushan Gongbi died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，歲星犯左執法。

translations.literal: On gengxu Jupiter trespassed against Left Law Enforcement.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Jupiter trespassed against Left Law Enforcement.

sentences.zh: 右丞相高汝礪表乞致仕，詔溫留之。

translations.literal: Right Chancellor Gao Ruli memorialized requesting retirement; an edict kindly retained him.
translations.idiomatic: Right Chancellor Gao Ruli asked to retire; a gracious edict kept him in office.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸丑，進汝礪官榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guichou: Ruli was advanced to Grand Master of Glorious Blessing.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on guichou, Ruli was promoted to Grand Master of Glorious Blessing.

sentences.zh: 命僕散毅夫行尚書省於京東，督諸軍芻糧。

translations.literal: Pusan Yifu was ordered to run the Secretariat in Jingdong and supervise fodder for all armies.
translations.idiomatic: Pusan Yifu was sent to run the Secretariat in Jingdong and oversee army fodder.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，太醫侯濟、張子英治皇孫疾，用藥瞑眩，皇孫不能任，遂不療，罪當死。

translations.literal: On yimao Imperial Physicians Hou Ji and Zhang Ziying treated the imperial grandson's illness; the medicine induced syncope; the grandson could not bear it and was left untreated — the penalty was death.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Imperial Physicians Hou Ji and Zhang Ziying treated the imperial grandson; the drugs caused fainting; the child could not endure them and went untreated — death was the statutory penalty.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「濟等所犯誠宜死，然在諸叔及弟兄之子，便應准法行之，以朕孫故殺人，所不忍也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Ji and the others indeed deserve death; yet among nephews and brothers' sons the law should simply be applied — to kill men because he is my grandson is what I cannot bear.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Ji and the others truly deserve death; but for nephews and brothers' sons the law should simply run — to execute them because he is my grandson is more than I can bear.

sentences.zh: 」命杖七十，除名。

translations.literal: " They were ordered beaten seventy strokes and their names struck.
translations.idiomatic: " They were given seventy strokes and struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 尚書省言：「司、縣官貪暴不法，部民逃亡，既有決罰，他縣停匿亦宜定罪。

translations.literal: The Secretariat said: "When prefectural and county officials are greedy, violent, and lawless and subjects flee, once sentence is passed, harboring in other counties should also be punished.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said, "When circuit and county officials are greedy and brutal and people flee, once they are sentenced, counties that shelter them should also be punished.

sentences.zh: 隨處土民久困徭役，客戶販鬻坐獲厚利，官無所斂，亦宜稍及客戶，以寬土民。

translations.literal: Everywhere native householders are long burdened by corvée; client households trading sit with thick profits while the state collects nothing — clients should also be lightly touched to ease the natives."
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere natives are worn down by corvée while client traders reap heavy profits the state never reaches — clients too should bear a little tax to relieve the natives."

sentences.zh: 行院帥府幕職，雖無部眾，亦嘗贊畫戎功，而推賞止進官一階，宜聽主將保奏，第功行賞。

translations.literal: Traveling secretariat and marshalate staff posts, though without commands, often helped plan military merit; yet promotion rewards only one rank — commanding generals should be allowed to recommend by graded merit."
translations.idiomatic: Staff of traveling secretariats and marshalates, though without troops, often helped plan campaigns, yet rewards advanced them only one rank — let commanders recommend them by graded merit."

sentences.zh: 」上皆從其請。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved all these requests.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor granted every request.

sentences.zh: 戊午，遣親軍討河南群盜。

translations.literal: On wuwu the personal guard was sent to suppress Henan bandit gangs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu the personal guard was dispatched against Henan bandit bands.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大元兵攻綏德州。

translations.literal: On xinyou Great Yuan forces attacked Suide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Great Yuan troops attacked Suide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，夏人復侵龕谷。

translations.literal: On renxu Xia again invaded Kan Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Xia again invaded Kan Valley.

sentences.zh: 甲子，敕監察所彈事，同列不可預聞，著為令。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict ruled that impeachment matters at the oversight office must not be heard in advance by colleagues on the same panel — set as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict barred colleagues on the same panel from learning impeachment cases at the oversight office in advance — made a standing rule.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，夏人犯定西、積石之境。

translations.literal: On dingmao Xia entered the borders of Dingxi and Jishi.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Xia crossed into Dingxi and Jishi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，分京畿戍卒萬二千，河中民兵八千，以許州元帥紇石烈鶴壽將之，屯潼關西。

translations.literal: On wuyin twelve thousand capital-region garrison troops and eight thousand Hezhong militia were assigned; Xu Prefecture Marshal Geshilie Heshou was to command them and encamp west of Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin twelve thousand capital garrison troops and eight thousand Hezhong militia were detached under Xu Prefecture Marshal Geshilie Heshou, posted west of Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，陝西東路行省報安塞堡敗夏人之捷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guiwei: Shaanxi East Route Branch Secretariat reported victory over Xia at Anse Fort.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on guiwei, the Shaanxi East Route Branch Secretariat reported victory over Xia at Anse Fort.

sentences.zh: 甲申，諭太府減損食品。

translations.literal: On jiashen the court ordered the Grand Storehouse to cut food supplies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the throne told the Grand Storehouse to reduce provisions.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，募民興南陽水田。

translations.literal: On gengyin commoners were recruited to develop Nanyang paddy fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the court recruited commoners to open Nanyang paddy land.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太子、親王、百官表賀安塞堡之捷，卻之。

translations.literal: On renchen the crown prince, imperial princes, and the hundred officials submitted congratulatory memorials on the Anse Fort victory — the throne declined them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the crown prince, princes, and officials memorialized to congratulate the Anse Fort victory; the throne declined the tables.

sentences.zh: 乙未，夏人攻龕穀。

translations.literal: On yiwei Xia attacked Kan Valley.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Xia attacked Kan Valley.

sentences.zh: 宋人攻蘄縣。

translations.literal: Song forces attacked Qi County.
translations.idiomatic: Song attacked Qi County.

sentences.zh: 紅襖賊掠宿州。

translations.literal: Red-Robe bandits plundered Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Red-Robe bandits raided Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，詔蠲徐、邳、宿、泗等州逋租，官民有能墾辟閒田，除來年科征。

translations.literal: On xinchou an edict remitted arrears in Xu, Pi, Su, and Si prefectures; officials and commoners who could reclaim idle land were exempted from next year's levies.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou an edict canceled back rent in Xu, Pi, Su, and Si; officials and commoners who reclaimed idle fields were spared next year's levies.

sentences.zh: 歸德、亳、壽、潁停閣逋戶租外，仍蠲三之一。

translations.literal: At Guide, Bozhou, Shou, and Ying, apart from suspending absent-household rents, a third was still remitted.
translations.idiomatic: At Guide, Bozhou, Shou, and Ying, besides halting absent-household rent, a third of the arrears was still forgiven.

sentences.zh: 逋戶田廬有司募民承業，禁其毀損，以俟來復。

translations.literal: For delinquent households' fields and dwellings the offices were to recruit commoners to take over the holdings, forbid damage, and wait for the owners' return.
translations.idiomatic: Delinquent tenants' fields and houses were to be farmed by recruits the offices enlisted, with damage forbidden until the owners came back.

sentences.zh: 蒲城縣民李文秀等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: At Pucheng County the commoners Li Wenxiu and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Wenxiu and other commoners of Pucheng County plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，宋人焚潁州，執防禦判官而去。

translations.literal: On renyin Song burned Ying Prefecture and carried off the defense and adjudication commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: That day Song torched Ying Prefecture and took the defense commissioner prisoner.

sentences.zh: 是日，相國寺火。

translations.literal: That day Xiangguo Temple caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: The same day Xiangguo Temple burned.

sentences.zh: 大元兵攻延安。

translations.literal: Great Yuan forces attacked Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan troops attacked Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛亥朔，以大元兵下潼關、京兆，詔省院議之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, xinhai new moon: with Great Yuan troops having taken Tong Pass and Jingzhao, ministries and agencies were ordered to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: On the twelfth month's xinhai new moon, with Great Yuan forces down through Tong Pass and Jingzhao, the Secretariat and agencies were told to confer.

sentences.zh: 壬子，罷避舉縣令法。

translations.literal: On renzi the law avoiding appointment of examination graduates as county magistrates was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the statute letting graduates avoid county magistrate posts was repealed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，禮部侍郎烏古孫仲端、翰林待制安庭珍使北還，各遷一階。

translations.literal: On dingsi Ministry of Rites Vice Minister Wugulun Zhongduan and Hanlin Awaiting Draft Compiler An Tingzhen returned from the northern mission; each was promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Wugulun Zhongduan, vice minister of rites, and Hanlin awaiting-draft compiler An Tingzhen came back from the north; each rose one grade.

sentences.zh: 庚申，罷河南義軍。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Henan Loyal Army was disbanded.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Henan Loyal Army was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔罷新簽民軍，減樞密院掌兵官及京城戍兵，仍諭行院帥府，毋擅增設補簽。

translations.literal: On dingmao an edict disbanded newly enrolled civilian militia, reduced Privy Council military officers and capital garrison troops, and warned traveling secretariats and marshal headquarters not to add enrollments on their own.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict ended new militia sign-ups, cut Privy Council troop officers and capital garrisons, and warned traveling secretariats and marshalates against unauthorized enrollments.

sentences.zh: 辛未，罷行總管府及招討統軍檢察等司。

translations.literal: On xinwei traveling chief steward offices and pacification, command, and inspection offices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei traveling chief steward offices and pacification, command, and inspection bureaus were abolished.

sentences.zh: 定宋人來歸賞格及詐誘征防軍人逃亡罪法。

translations.literal: Reward scales for Song defectors and penalties for fraudulently inducing frontier troops to desert were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Rewards for Song men who came over and penalties for tricking frontier troops into deserting were set.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，元帥合達買住及其將士以延安功特賞賚之，仍下詔獎諭。

translations.literal: On guiyou Marshal Wanyan Hedà Maizhu and his officers and soldiers received special rewards for merit at Yan'an, with a commendatory edict.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Marshal Wanyan Hedà Maizhu and his troops were richly rewarded for Yan'an and praised by edict.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳朔，大元兵徇鄜州，保大軍節度使完顏六斤、權元帥右都監紇石烈鶴壽、右都監蒲察婁室、遙授金安軍節度使女奚烈資祿皆死之。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, xinsi new moon: Great Yuan troops advanced on Bin Prefecture; Bao Great Army Military Commissioner Wanyan Liujin, Acting Right Marshal Deputy Overseer Geshilie Heshou, Right Deputy Overseer Pucha Loushi, and Remotely Conferred Jin'an Army Military Commissioner Nuxilie Zilu all died.
translations.idiomatic: On the intercalary month's xinsi new moon Great Yuan forces took Bin Prefecture; Bao Great Army commissioner Wanyan Liujin, acting right marshal deputy overseer Geshilie Heshou, right deputy overseer Pucha Loushi, and remotely conferred Jin'an Army commissioner Nuxilie Zilu all fell.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，提控朮甲咬住破沈丘賊于陳瓦。

translations.literal: On yiyou Control Officer Shujia Yaozhu defeated Shenqiu bandits at Chenwa.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Control Officer Shujia Yaozhu routed Shenqiu rebels at Chenwa.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，頒詔撫諭河南土寇。

translations.literal: On bingxu an edict was promulgated to pacify Henan local bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu an edict went out to soothe Henan native bandits.

sentences.zh: 戊子，熒惑犯軒轅。

translations.literal: On wuzi Mars trespassed the Xuanyuan asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Mars crossed the Xuanyuan asterism.

sentences.zh: 己丑，孫瑀及捕盜官吾古出招降泰和縣賊二千人，詔斬其首惡，餘皆釋之。

translations.literal: On jichou Sun Yu and bandit-capture officer Wugu Chu induced two thousand Taihe County rebels to surrender; an edict ordered the ringleaders executed and the rest released.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Sun Yu and bandit-capture officer Wugu Chu talked two thousand Taihe County rebels into surrender; an edict beheaded the leaders and freed the rest.

sentences.zh: 同知保靜軍節度使郭澍以征糧失期，誣殺平民，坐誅。

translations.literal: Acting Baojing Army Military Commissioner Guo Shu, for failing to deliver levy grain on schedule and falsely killing civilians, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Acting Baojing Army commissioner Guo Shu, who missed levy grain deadlines and murdered civilians on false charges, was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，官軍復葭州。

translations.literal: On xinmao government troops recovered Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao government forces retook Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，通遠軍節度使孛朮魯合住削官。

translations.literal: On guisi Tongyuan Army Military Commissioner Beipailu Hezhu was stripped of office.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Tongyuan Army commissioner Beipailu Hezhu lost his post.

sentences.zh: 甲午，月犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On jiawu the moon trespassed Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the moon crossed Mars.

sentences.zh: 丙申，紅襖賊入蒙城縣，縣官失其符印，軍民死者甚眾，賊大掠而去。

translations.literal: On bingshen Red-Robe bandits entered Mengcheng County; county officials lost their seals and tallies; many soldiers and civilians died; the bandits looted heavily and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Red-Robe rebels entered Mengcheng; the county magistrate lost seal and tally; soldiers and civilians died in great numbers; the rebels plundered and left.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，鎮星晝見於軫。

translations.literal: On wuxu Saturn appeared in daylight in the Zhen mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Saturn was seen by day in the Zhen lodge.

sentences.zh: 己亥，發兵捕京東盜。

translations.literal: On jihai troops were dispatched against Jingdong bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai troops were sent to hunt Jingdong bandits.

sentences.zh: 太白晝見於室。

translations.literal: Venus appeared in daylight in the Shi mansion.
translations.idiomatic: Venus showed by day in the Shi lodge.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，發上林署粟賑貧民。

translations.literal: On renyin grain from the Superior Park Office was issued to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Superior Park grain was opened to feed the destitute.

sentences.zh: 陳、亳等州，鹿邑、城父諸縣，盜蜂起，趣樞府遣官討之。

translations.literal: In Chen, Bozhou, and other prefectures and in Luyi, Chengfu, and other counties bandits swarmed; the Privy Council was urgently told to send officers against them.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rose in Chen, Bozhou, and other prefectures and in Luyi, Chengfu, and other counties; the Privy Council was pressed to send officers against them.

sentences.zh: 捕盜軍所過殘民，遣御史一人按視。

translations.literal: Where bandit-suppression armies harmed the people, one censor was sent to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When bandit-hunting troops harmed civilians, one censor was dispatched to review the case.

sentences.zh: 軍所獲牛，有司以官錢收贖。

translations.literal: Cattle taken by the armies were to be ransomed by the offices with official funds.
translations.idiomatic: Oxen seized by the troops were to be bought back with public money.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔定招捕土寇官賞格。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict fixed reward scales for officials who recruited and captured local bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict set rewards for officials who raised and caught native bandits.

sentences.zh: 己酉，更造「興定寶泉」，每一貫當「通寶」四百貫。

translations.literal: On jiyou new "Xingding Treasure Spring" coins were minted, each string equivalent to four hundred strings of Tongbao.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou new Xingding Treasure Spring cash was cast, each string worth four hundred Tongbao strings.

sentences.zh: 元光年春正月庚戌朔，免朝。

translations.literal: Yuanguang year, spring, first month, gengxu new moon: court audience was waived.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanguang year, on the first month's gengxu new moon, morning audience was excused.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，世宗忌辰，謁奠于啟慶宮。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Shizong's death anniversary, libation was offered at Qiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, Shizong's death anniversary, the court offered libation at Qiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 元帥惟弼破紅襖賊于張騫店。

translations.literal: Marshal Weibi defeated Red-Robe bandits at Zhangqian Inn.
translations.idiomatic: Marshal Weibi routed Red-Robe rebels at Zhangqian Inn.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣官墾種京東、西、南三路水田。

translations.literal: On renzi officials were sent to reclaim and plant paddy in the three Jingdong, Jingxi, and Jingnan circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi officers were sent to open paddy in the Jingdong, Jingxi, and Jingnan circuits.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，禁非邊關急速事無馳傳，有濫乘者州縣徑白省部，四方館從御史臺，外路從分按御史治之。

translations.literal: On jiayin relay mounts were forbidden except for urgent border matters; unauthorized riders were to be reported directly by prefectures and counties to the ministries, lodge visitors to the censorate, and outer circuits to touring censors for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin urgent relay mounts were barred except for pressing border business; abusers were to be reported by prefectures and counties straight to the ministries, Four Directions Hostel guests to the censorate, and outer routes to assigned touring censors.

sentences.zh: 詔陝西西路行省徙京兆者，兵退還治平涼。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that for the Shaanxi West Circuit traveling secretariat officials who had moved to Jingzhao, once the troops withdrew they were to return and govern from Pingliang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled that Shaanxi West Circuit officials who had shifted to Jingzhao should return to govern from Pingliang once the troops withdrew.

sentences.zh: 坊州刺史把移失剌以棄城，伏誅。

translations.literal: Fang Prefecture Prefect Bayi Shila, for abandoning the city, was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Prefecture Prefect Bayi Shila was put to death for abandoning his city.

sentences.zh: 鄭州防禦使裴滿羊哥、同知防禦使古裏甲石倫除名。

translations.literal: Zheng Prefecture Defense Commissioner Peiman Yangge and Acting Defense Commissioner Gurijia Shilun were struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Prefecture Defense Commissioner Peiman Yangge and Acting Defense Commissioner Gurijia Shilun were removed from office.

sentences.zh: 平西節度使把古咬住奪官一階。

translations.literal: Pingxi Military Commissioner Bagu Yaozhu was stripped one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Pingxi Military Commissioner Bagu Yaozhu lost one rank.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔撫諭京東百姓。

translations.literal: On dingmao an edict comforted and instructed the people of Jingdong.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict reassured the people of Jingdong.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，詔徙中京、唐、鄧、商、虢、許、陝等州屯軍及諸軍家屬赴京兆、同、華就糧屯。

translations.literal: Second month, renwu: an edict moved garrison troops and all army households of Central Capital, Tang, Deng, Shang, Guo, Xu, and Shan prefectures and other garrisons to Jingzhao, Tong, and Hua for grain and encampment.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renwu, an edict shifted garrison troops and army households from Central Capital, Tang, Deng, Shang, Guo, Xu, Shan, and other garrison prefectures to Jingzhao, Tong, and Hua for grain and settlement.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，陝西西路行省請以厚賞募河西蕃部族寺僧，圖復大通城，命行省樞密院籌之。

translations.literal: On yiyou the Shaanxi West Circuit traveling secretariat requested using rich rewards to recruit Tibetan tribal monks and temple monks of Hexi to plan recovery of Datong Fort; the court ordered the traveling secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs to work it out.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Shaanxi West Circuit asked to offer heavy rewards to recruit Hexi Tibetan tribes and temple monks to retake Datong Fort; the court told the traveling secretariat and Military Affairs Bureau to plan it.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，上諭宰臣，宋人以重兵攻平輿、褒信，我師力戰卻之，又偵知其事狀之詳。

translations.literal: On guisi the emperor told the chief ministers: "Song sent heavy forces against Pingyu and Baoxin; our troops fought hard and drove them off, and we also learned the full details of their plans.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the emperor told the chief ministers, "Song threw heavy forces at Pingyu and Baoxin; our troops fought hard and beat them back, and we now know their plans in detail.

sentences.zh: 若俟帥府上功推賞，豈急於勸獎之道？

translations.literal: If we wait for the marshal headquarters to report merit and push rewards, how can that match the need to encourage men promptly?"
translations.idiomatic: If we wait for marshal headquarters to report merit before rewards, how does that hurry men along?"

sentences.zh: 其遣清望官，齎空名宣敕，核實給之。

translations.literal: " He ordered high-standing officials sent bearing blank patent letters and edicts to verify and grant rewards on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent senior officials with blank patents and edicts to verify merit and reward it on the spot.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔諭河南、陝西。

translations.literal: On yiwei an edict instructed Henan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei an edict instructed Henan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 大元兵屯葭州。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops encamped at Jia Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan troops encamped at Jia Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，權定行省、樞府、元帥府輒杖左右司、經歷司官罪法。

translations.literal: On renyin provisional traveling secretariats, military bureaus, and marshal headquarters were given penal law for summarily beating officials of the left and right secretariat offices and the experience office.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin an edict set penalties for provisional secretariats, military bureaus, and marshal headquarters that beat officials of the left and right secretariat offices or the experience office without process.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上念鄜延被兵，又延安受圍，嘗發民粟給軍。

translations.literal: On jiachen the emperor, mindful that Fuyan had suffered warfare and Yan'an was besieged and had once levied civilian grain for the army,
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, remembering that Fuyan had been ravaged and Yan'an besieged and that civilian grain had once been taken for the army,

sentences.zh: 詔除延安、鄜、坊、丹、葭、綏德稅租，仍令有司償其粟直，不足者許補官。

translations.literal: ordered tax and rent remitted for Yan'an, Fu, Fang, Dan, Jia, and Suide, and also told the responsible offices to repay the grain price, with shortfalls allowed to be made up by appointment purchase.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor remitted taxes for Yan'an, Fu, Fang, Dan, Jia, and Suide and told the offices to repay grain taken, with shortfalls payable through appointment purchase.

sentences.zh: 戊申，恆州軍變，萬戶呼延棫等千餘人殺掠城中，焚廬舍而去。

translations.literal: On wushen Heng Prefecture mutinied; Commander Hu Yan Yu and more than a thousand men killed and plundered in the city, burned houses, and left.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Heng Prefecture mutinied; Commander Hu Yan Yu and more than a thousand men killed and looted the city, burned houses, and fled.

sentences.zh: 己酉，遣元帥左監軍訛可行元帥府事，節制三路軍馬伐宋，同簽樞密院事時全行院事，副之。

translations.literal: On jiyou Left Marshal Supervisor Eke was sent to conduct marshal headquarters affairs, control the three-route armies to attack Song, and Military Affairs Co-signer Shi Quan was to run bureau affairs as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Left Marshal Supervisor Eke was sent to run marshal headquarters affairs and command the three-route armies against Song, with Military Affairs Co-signer Shi Quan as his deputy running bureau affairs.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，宋人掠確山縣之劉村。
