translations.literal: Third month, xinyou: Song raided Liu Village in Queshan County.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinyou, Song raided Liu Village in Queshan County.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，歲星犯太微左執法。

translations.literal: On bingyin Jupiter trespassed against Left Law Enforcement of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Jupiter trespassed against Left Law Enforcement of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，樞密院委差官賈天安上書言利害。

translations.literal: On wuchen Bureau of Military Affairs commissioned officer Jia Tian'an memorialized on benefits and harms.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Military Affairs commissioned officer Jia Tian'an memorialized on policy.

sentences.zh: 壬申，尚書右丞徒單思忠以病馬輸官，冒取高價，御史劾之，有司以監主自盜論死，上顧惜大體，降授陳州防禦使。

translations.literal: On renshen Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Tushan Sizhong, for presenting a sick horse to the government yet taking a high price, was impeached by the censor; the responsible offices sentenced him to death as supervising official who stole from himself; the emperor, caring for the larger interest, demoted him to Chenzhou Defense Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Right Vice Director Tushan Sizhong, for turning in a sick horse yet taking a high price, was impeached; the offices sentenced him to death as supervising thief of government property; the emperor, mindful of larger interests, demoted him to Chenzhou Defense Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，提控李師林敗夏人於永木嶺。

translations.literal: On guiyou Control Commissioner Li Shilin defeated Xia forces at Yongmu Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Control Commissioner Li Shilin defeated Xia forces at Yongmu Ridge.

sentences.zh: 郭文振表，近得俘者言，南北合兵將攻河南、陝西。

translations.literal: Guo Wenzhen memorialized that recent captives said north and south would join forces to attack Henan and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Wenzhen reported that recent captives said north and south would join to attack Henan and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 詔樞密備禦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Bureau of Military Affairs to prepare defenses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Military Affairs to prepare defenses.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，以金吾衛上將軍、勸農使訛可簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinsi: Golden Crow Guard General-in-chief and Agriculture Encouragement Commissioner Eke was made signer of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on xinsi, Golden Crow Guard General-in-chief and Agriculture Encouragement Commissioner Eke was made Military Affairs signer.

sentences.zh: 置大司農司，設大司農卿、少卿、丞，京東、西、南三路置行司，並兼採訪事。

translations.literal: The Grand Agriculture Commission was established, with a grand minister, vice minister, and aide; traveling commissions were set on the East, West, and South circuits, all also charged with inspection tours.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Agriculture Commission was set up with grand minister, vice minister, and aide; traveling commissions on the East, West, and South circuits were also charged with inspection.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大元兵攻陵川縣。

translations.literal: On renwu Great Yuan troops attacked Lingchuan County.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Great Yuan troops attacked Lingchuan County.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，林懷路行元帥府事惟良削官兩階，罷之。

translations.literal: On dingyou Linhuailu Traveling Marshalate Acting Marshal Wei Liang was stripped two ranks and dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Linhuailu Traveling Marshalate Acting Marshal Wei Liang lost two ranks and was removed.

sentences.zh: 更定辟舉縣令之法，而復行之。

translations.literal: The law for nominating county magistrates was revised and put back into effect.
translations.idiomatic: Rules for nominating county magistrates were revised and restored.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，籍丁憂待闕、追殿等官，備防秋。

translations.literal: On wuxu officials in mourning awaiting appointment or chasing backlogs were registered to prepare for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu officials in mourning, awaiting appointment, or clearing backlogs were registered for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 丁未，行樞密院報淮南之捷。

translations.literal: On dingwei the traveling Bureau of Military Affairs reported victory in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the traveling Military Affairs Bureau reported victory in Huainan.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申朔，大元兵屯隰、吉、翼等州。

translations.literal: Fifth month, wushen new moon: Great Yuan troops encamped at Xi, Ji, and Yi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the wushen new moon, Great Yuan troops encamped at Xi, Ji, and Yi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，訛可、時全軍大敗。

translations.literal: On renxu Eke's and Shi Quan's armies were heavily defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the armies of Eke and Shi Quan were routed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，訛可以敗績當死，上面數而責之，勉其後效命，朘官兩階。

translations.literal: On jiazi Eke deserved death for defeat; the emperor counted his faults and rebuked him, urged him to serve better hereafter, and reduced his rank two steps.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Eke merited death for defeat; the emperor listed his faults, rebuked him, urged better service hereafter, and cut his rank two steps.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，召致政胥鼎等赴省議利害。

translations.literal: On dingmao retired officials Xu Ding and others were summoned to the secretariat to discuss benefits and harms.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao retired officials Xu Ding and others were called to the secretariat to discuss policy.

sentences.zh: 壬申，時全伏誅。

translations.literal: On renshen Shi Quan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Shi Quan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅朔，造舟運陝西糧，由大慶關渡抵湖城。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuyin new moon: boats were built to transport Shaanxi grain, crossing by Daqing Pass to reach Hucheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the wuyin new moon, boats were built to ship Shaanxi grain across Daqing Pass to Hucheng.

sentences.zh: 癸未，大赦。

translations.literal: On guiwei there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei there was a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 陳州防禦使呂子羽坐乏軍興，自盡。

translations.literal: Chenzhou Defense Commissioner Lü Ziyu, charged with failing military provisioning, committed suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Chenzhou Defense Commissioner Lü Ziyu, charged with failing army supply, killed himself.

sentences.zh: 制諸監官及八品以下職事，丁憂、待闕、任滿、遙授者，試補侍衛親軍。

translations.literal: It was ordered that supervisory officials and functionaries of eighth rank and below who were in mourning, awaiting appointment, at term end, or remotely commissioned should be tested and appointed to the personal guard.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory officials and eighth-rank functionaries in mourning, awaiting appointment, at term end, or on remote commission were to be tested for the personal guard.

sentences.zh: 命各路司農司設捕盜方略。

translations.literal: Each circuit's agriculture commission was ordered to set bandit-catching plans.
translations.idiomatic: Each circuit agriculture commission was told to draft bandit-suppression plans.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，紅襖賊掠柳子鎮，驅百姓及驛馬而去，提控張瑀追擊，奪所掠還。

translations.literal: On dingyou Red Coat bandits raided Liuzi town, drove off the people and relay horses, and Control Commissioner Zhang Yu pursued, recovered what was taken, and returned it.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Red Coat bandits raided Liuzi town, drove off people and relay horses; Control Commissioner Zhang Yu pursued, took back the loot, and restored it.

sentences.zh: 偽監軍王二據黎陽縣，提控王泉討之，復其城。

translations.literal: The false military inspector Wang Er held Liyang County; Control Commissioner Wang Quan attacked him and recovered the city.
translations.idiomatic: False military inspector Wang Er held Liyang County; Control Commissioner Wang Quan attacked him and retook the city.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌，大元將按察鄔以其眾屯晉安、冀州之境。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, gengxu: Great Yuan General Ancha Wu encamped his forces on the borders of Jin'an and Ji prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on gengxu, Great Yuan General Ancha Wu encamped on the Jin'an and Ji prefecture borders.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上党公完顏開復澤州。

translations.literal: On bingchen Duke of Shangdang Wanyan Kai recovered Ze Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Duke of Shangdang Wanyan Kai retook Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己未，歸德行樞密院王庭玉報曹州破紅襖賊之捷。

translations.literal: On jiwei Guiding Traveling Bureau of Military Affairs Wang Tingyu reported victory over Red Coat bandits at Caozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Guiding Traveling Military Affairs Wang Tingyu reported victory over Red Coat bandits at Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 庚申，定監當官選法。

translations.literal: On gengshen the law for selecting supervisory duty officials was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen rules for selecting supervisory duty officials were set.

sentences.zh: 河北群盜犯封丘、開封界，令樞密院禦捕。

translations.literal: Hebei bandit gangs invaded the borders of Fengqiu and Kaifeng; the Bureau of Military Affairs was ordered to defend and suppress them.
translations.idiomatic: Hebei bandit bands crossed into Fengqiu and Kaifeng; Military Affairs was ordered to defend and suppress them.

sentences.zh: 甲子，京東總帥紇石烈牙吾塔請自今行院帥府幕職，有過得自決之。

translations.literal: On jiazi Shandong East overall commander Heshilie Yawuta requested that from now on staff of traveling secretariats and marshal headquarters who erred might be punished on their own authority.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Shandong East overall commander Heshilie Yawuta asked that traveling secretariat and marshalate staff who erred might be punished on the spot.

sentences.zh: 不允。

translations.literal: It was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，紅襖賊襲徐州之十八里砦，又襲古城、桃園，官軍破之。

translations.literal: On wuchen Red-cloak bandits raided the Eighteen-li Stockade of Xu Prefecture, also raided Gucheng and Taoyuan; government troops defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Red-cloak rebels hit Xu Prefecture's Eighteen-li Stockade and also Gucheng and Taoyuan; government troops beat them off.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，太白晝見經天，與日爭光。

translations.literal: On yihai Venus appeared in daylight crossing the sky, competing in brightness with the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Venus crossed the sky by day, rivaling the sun in brilliance.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，定西征將士官賞有差。

translations.literal: Eighth month, dingchou: graded rewards were set for Western Expedition generals and officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Western Expedition officers and officials received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 己卯，彗星見西方。

translations.literal: On jimao a comet appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao a comet showed in the west.

sentences.zh: 甲申，增定藏匿逃亡親軍罪及告捕賞格。

translations.literal: On jiashen penalties and informant rewards were increased for concealing deserting personal guards.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the court stiffened penalties and informant bounties for hiding deserting household guards.

sentences.zh: 積石州蕃族叛附于夏，鞏州提控尼旁古三郎討之，獲羊千口，進尚膳，詔卻之。

translations.literal: Jishi Prefecture Tibetans rebelled and submitted to Xia; Gong Prefecture control commissioner Nipanggu Sanlang attacked them, obtained a thousand sheep, and presented them to the imperial kitchens; an edict returned them.
translations.idiomatic: Tibetans of Jishi Prefecture rebelled and went over to Xia; Gong Prefecture control commissioner Nipanggu Sanlang attacked them, took a thousand sheep, and sent them to the palace kitchens; the throne sent them back.

sentences.zh: 以彗星見，改元，大赦。

translations.literal: On sight of the comet the era name was changed and a great amnesty proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: Because of the comet the era name was changed and a great amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 諭旨宰臣曰：「赦書已頒，時刻之間，人命所系。

translations.literal: Edict to chief councillors said: "The amnesty edict has been promulgated; in moments human lives hang in the balance.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the chief councillors, "The amnesty has gone out; in moments lives hang in the balance.

sentences.zh: 其令將命者速往，計期而至。

translations.literal: Order those bearing the command to go swiftly and arrive within the set term."
translations.idiomatic: Have the bearers hurry there and reach their destinations on schedule."

sentences.zh: 」以大司農把胡魯為參知政事。

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Agriculture Ba Hulu was made Vice Participation Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Agriculture Ba Hulu was made vice participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，河間公移剌眾家奴、高陽公張甫兵復河間府，是日，報捷者始達。

translations.literal: On guisi Prince of Hejian Yila Zongjianu and Duke of Gaoyang Zhang Fu with troops recovered Hejian Prefecture; that day the victory report first arrived.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Prince of Hejian Yila Zongjianu and Duke of Gaoyang Zhang Fu retook Hejian Prefecture; the victory report reached court that same day.

sentences.zh: 上以道途梗塞，報者艱虞，命厚賞之。

translations.literal: Because roads were blocked and messengers faced hardship, the emperor ordered generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: With roads cut and couriers struggling, the emperor ordered rich rewards.

sentences.zh: 夏人入德順。

translations.literal: Xia forces entered Deshun.
translations.idiomatic: Xia forces entered Deshun.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，祈雨。

translations.literal: On renyin rain was prayed for.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the court prayed for rain.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午朔，以左右警巡使兼彈壓。

translations.literal: Ninth month, bingwu new moon: left and right patrol commissioners were additionally charged with suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the bingwu new moon, left and right patrol commissioners were also made suppression officers.

sentences.zh: 諭陝西行省備邊。

translations.literal: Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was instructed to ready the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was told to ready the frontier.

sentences.zh: 壬子，牙吾塔請以兵由壽州渡淮，搗宋人巢穴，不從。

translations.literal: On renzi Yawuta asked to lead troops from Shou Prefecture across the Huai to strike Song nests; it was not approved.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Hesheli Yawuta asked to cross the Huai from Shou Prefecture and smash Song bases; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，議經略淮南。

translations.literal: On yimao Huainan strategy was debated.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao the court debated strategy for Huainan.

sentences.zh: 己巳，宋人掠遂平縣之石砦店，復侵南陽，唐州提控夾穀九住敗之。

translations.literal: On jisi Song raided the Shizhai shop of Suiping County and again invaded Nanyang; Tang Prefecture control commissioner Jiagu Jiuzhu defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Song raided Suiping County's Shizhai market and struck Nanyang again; Tang Prefecture control commissioner Jiagu Jiuzhu drove them back.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁丑，夏人掠德順之神林堡。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, dingchou: Xia raided the Shenlin Fort of Deshun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on dingchou, Xia raided Deshun's Shenlin Fort.

sentences.zh: 壬午，宋張惠攻零子鎮，為斡魯朵所敗，虜其裨將二人。

translations.literal: On renwu Song Zhang Hui attacked Lingzi Fort; Woluduo defeated him and captured two deputy generals.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Song's Zhang Hui attacked Lingzi Fort; Woluduo routed him and took two deputy generals prisoner.

sentences.zh: 河中府萬戶孫仲威執其安撫使阿不罕胡魯剌據城叛，陝西行省遣將討平之。

translations.literal: Hezhong prefecture ten-thousand-household commander Sun Zhongwei seized pacification commissioner Abuhan Hulula and held the city in rebellion; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat sent generals to suppress and pacify it.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong ten-thousand-household commander Sun Zhongwei seized pacification commissioner Abuhan Hulula and rebelled, holding the city; the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat sent generals to suppress him and restore order.

sentences.zh: 癸未，復曹州。

translations.literal: On guiwei Caozhou was recovered.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Caozhou was recovered.

sentences.zh: 甲申，上獵於近郊，詔免百官送迎，且勿令治道，以勞百姓。

translations.literal: On jiashen the emperor hunted in the near suburbs; an edict excused officials from welcoming escort and forbade preparing the road, to spare the people labor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the emperor hunted near the capital; an edict excused officials from escort duty and forbade road work so the people would not be burdened.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，徙彰德招撫使杜先軍于衛州。

translations.literal: On gengyin Zhangde pacification commissioner Du Xianjun's army was moved to Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Zhangde pacification commissioner Du Xianjun's force was shifted to Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙未，大元兵下榮州之胡壁堡及臨晉。

translations.literal: On yiwei Great Yuan troops took Hubi Fort of Rongzhou and Linfen.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Great Yuan forces seized Rongzhou's Hubi Fort and Linfen.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔所司巡護避兵民資產。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict ordered relevant offices to patrol and protect war-refugees' property.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict ordered the offices to guard refugees' property from war.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以京兆官民避兵南山者多至百萬，詔兼同知府事完顏霆等安撫其眾。

translations.literal: On jiachen because more than a million Chang'an officials and people fleeing war had reached the Southern Hills, Wanyan Ting and others acting as concurrent prefectural administrators were ordered to soothe the masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, with more than a million Chang'an officials and commoners fleeing war into the Southern Hills, Wanyan Ting and other acting prefectural administrators were ordered to settle the crowds.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁未，大元兵徇同州，定國軍節度使李復亨、同知定國軍節度使訛可皆自盡。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, dingwei: Great Yuan troops overran Tongzhou; Dingguo Army Military Commissioner Li Fuheng and Acting Dingguo Military Commissioner Eke both killed themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingwei, Great Yuan forces overran Tongzhou; Dingguo Army commissioner Li Fuheng and acting commissioner Eke both killed themselves.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，京東總帥牙吾塔報臨淮破宋兵之捷。

translations.literal: On jiayin Eastern Capital Route commander Yawuta reported victory breaking Song troops at Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Eastern Capital Route commander Hesheli Yawuta reported victory over Song at Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，大元蒙古蒲花攻鳳翔府。

translations.literal: On wuchen Great Yuan Mongol Puhua attacked Fengxiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Great Yuan general Mongol Puhua attacked Fengxiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥朔，上謂皇太子曰：「吾嘗夜思天下事，必索燭以記，明而即行，汝亦當然。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, yihai new moon: the emperor told the crown prince: "I often think of empire's affairs at night and must have candles lit to record them; at dawn I act—you should do the same."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the yihai new moon, the emperor told the crown prince, "I think over the realm at night and must light candles to write it down, then act at dawn—you should do the same."

sentences.zh: 」以河中治中侯小叔權元帥府右都監，許便宜行事。

translations.literal: Hezhong administration vice-director Hou Xiaoshu was made acting marshalate right army overseer with discretionary authority.
translations.idiomatic: Hezhong administration vice-director Hou Xiaoshu was made acting marshalate right army overseer with discretionary powers.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遷同知平陽府事史詠龍虎衛上將軍，賜號「守節忠臣」，權行平陽公府事。

translations.literal: On yiyou Acting Pingyang vice prefect Shi Yong was made Tiger-Guard Senior General, granted the title "Loyalist Who Keeps Integrity," and authorized to administer Pingyang ducal headquarters affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou acting Pingyang vice prefect Shi Yong became Tiger-Guard senior general, received the title Loyalist Who Keeps Integrity, and was empowered to run Pingyang ducal headquarters affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，疊州總管青宜可卒，特命其子角襲職。

translations.literal: On dinghai Diezhou route commander Qing Yike died; his son Jiao was specially ordered to inherit the post.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Diezhou route commander Qing Yike died; his son Jiao was specially ordered to succeed him.

sentences.zh: 詔諭近侍局曰：「奉御、奉職皆少年，不知書。

translations.literal: An edict told the Inner Attendants Bureau: "Palace attendants and attendants-in-waiting are all youths who do not know books.
translations.idiomatic: An edict told the Inner Attendants Bureau, "Palace attendants and attendants-in-waiting are young and unlettered.

sentences.zh: 朕憶曩時置說書人，日為講論自古君臣父子之教，使知所以事上者，其復置。

translations.literal: I recall that in the past lecturers were installed to discourse daily on the teachings of ruler and minister, father and son, from antiquity so they would know how to serve their superiors—these should be restored."
translations.idiomatic: I remember lecturers once lectured daily on how rulers and ministers and fathers and sons should behave so they would know how to serve above them—restore that practice."

sentences.zh: 」己丑，蘭州提控唐括昉敗夏人於質孤堡。

translations.literal: On jichou Lanzhou control commissioner Tangguo Fang defeated Xia at Zhigu Fort.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Lanzhou control commissioner Tangguo Fang defeated Xia at Zhigu Fort.

sentences.zh: 大元以大軍攻鳳翔。

translations.literal: Great Yuan sent a large army against Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan sent a large force against Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月甲辰朔，詔免朝賀。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, jiachen new moon: an edict excused court congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on the first month's jiachen new moon, the court excused congratulatory audience.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，世宗忌日，謁奠于啟慶宮。

translations.literal: On yisi Shizong's death anniversary; libation was offered at Qiqing Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Shizong's death anniversary, libation was offered at Qiqing Palace.

sentences.zh: 右丞相汝礪乞致政，上面諭使留。

translations.literal: Right Chief Councillor Ru Li asked to retire; the emperor face-to-face instructed him to remain.
translations.idiomatic: Right chief councillor Ru Li asked to retire; the emperor told him face to face to stay.

sentences.zh: 大元兵下河中府，權元帥右都監侯小叔復之。

translations.literal: Great Yuan troops took Hezhong Prefecture; Acting Marshal Right Army Overseer Hou Xiaoshu recovered it.
translations.idiomatic: Great Yuan took Hezhong Prefecture; acting marshal right overseer Hou Xiaoshu retook it.

sentences.zh: 壬子，壽州防禦使完顏乃剌奪官四階。

translations.literal: On renzi Shouzhou defense commissioner Wanyan Naila was reduced four ranks in office.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Shouzhou defense commissioner Wanyan Naila was demoted four ranks.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上諭宰臣曰：「向有人言便宜事，卿等屢奏乞作中旨行之。

translations.literal: On jiayin the emperor told chief councillors: "Recently someone spoke of expedient measures and you repeatedly memorialized asking to carry them out as imperial directives.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the emperor told the chief councillors, "Someone lately spoke of expedient measures and you kept memorializing to execute them as imperial orders.

sentences.zh: 帝王從諫足矣，豈可掠人之美以為己出哉！

translations.literal: Emperors need only heed remonstrance—how can one seize others' merit and present it as one's own!
translations.idiomatic: An emperor need only accept remonstrance—how can you steal another's good idea and call it your own!

sentences.zh: 」戊午，四方館瘸驢以罪罷，宰臣請以散地羈縻之，上曰：「此輩豪傑，正須誠待，若以術制，適使自疑。

translations.literal: On wuwu Foreign Guests Bureau Que Lü was dismissed for crime; chief councillors asked to restrain him with a sinecure post; the emperor said: "These are bold spirits; they need sincere treatment—if you control them with tricks you will only make them suspicious.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Foreign Guests Bureau Que Lü was dismissed for an offense; the chief councillors asked to hold him on a nominal post; the emperor said, "Men like this are bold spirits and need honest handling—trick them with schemes and you only breed mistrust.

sentences.zh: 但不畀軍政，外補何害？

translations.literal: But if you do not give them military and civil power, what harm in an outside appointment?
translations.idiomatic: Just keep them from civil and military command—what harm in an outside appointment?

sentences.zh: 」授瘸驢恆州刺史。

translations.literal: Que Lü was appointed Hengzhou inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Que Lü was made inspector of Hengzhou.

sentences.zh: 又謂：「鬻爵恩例有丁憂官得起復者，是教人以不孝也，何為著此令哉？

translations.literal: He also said: "In the grace precedents for selling offices there are provisions that officials in mourning may be recalled from leave—this teaches people unfilial conduct; why put such a rule in writing?
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "The grace precedents for selling offices let mourning officials be recalled from bereavement leave—that teaches unfilial conduct; why write such a rule?

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，大元兵復下河中府。

translations.literal: " On dingmao Great Yuan troops again took Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingmao Great Yuan forces again seized Hezhong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌朔，皇后生辰，詔免賀禮。

translations.literal: Second month, jiaxu new moon: the empress's birthday; an edict excused congratulatory rites.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on the jiaxu new moon, the empress's birthday came; the court excused congratulatory rites.

sentences.zh: 己卯，丞相汝礪朝會，免拜，設榻殿下，久立賜休。

translations.literal: On jimao Grand Councillor Rulin attended audience; bowing was waived, a couch was set below the hall steps, and after long standing he was granted rest.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Grand Councillor Gao Rulin came to audience without bowing; a couch was placed below the hall, and after standing long he was told to rest.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔「軍官犯罪，舊制更不可任用，今多故之秋，人才難得，朕欲除大罪外，徒刑追配有武藝善掌兵者，量才復用。

translations.literal: On renwu an edict said: "When military officers commit crimes, the old rule barred reuse — but in these troubled times talent is hard to find. We wish that aside from grave crimes, those sentenced to penal service or exile who have martial skill and can command troops be re-employed according to ability.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu an edict said, "Military officers who commit crimes were once barred from reuse forever — yet in these troubled times talent is scarce. Aside from capital crimes, those sent to penal service or exile who have martial skill and can lead troops should be brought back as their ability warrants.

sentences.zh: 其令尚書省議以聞」。

translations.literal: Let the Masters of Writing deliberate and report."
translations.idiomatic: Have the Masters of Writing discuss this and report."

sentences.zh: 丁亥，大赦。

translations.literal: On dinghai there was a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the throne proclaimed a great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 己亥，鳳翔圍解。

translations.literal: On jihai the siege of Fengxiang was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the siege of Fengxiang was raised.

sentences.zh: 石盞合喜加金紫光祿大夫，升左監軍，特授大名府谷忽申猛安，完顏仲元加光祿大夫，升右監軍，特授河北東路洮委必剌猛安，各賜金鞶帶有差。

translations.literal: Shizhan Hehe was advanced to Golden Purple Glory Grandee, promoted to left army overseer, and specially made Guhushen meng'an of Daming Prefecture; Wanyan Zhongyuan was advanced to Glory Grandee, promoted to right army overseer, and specially made Taoweibila meng'an of the Hebei East Route — each was given gold belts in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhan Hehe rose to Golden Purple Glory Grandee and left army overseer and was specially named Guhushen meng'an of Daming; Wanyan Zhongyuan rose to Glory Grandee and right army overseer and was specially named Taoweibila meng'an on the Hebei East Route — each received a gold belt in due measure.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰朔，宋人襲汝陽。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen new moon: Song forces raided Ruyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the jiachen new moon, Song raided Ruyang.

sentences.zh: 壬子，誡諭平章英王守純崇飲。

translations.literal: On renzi an edict admonished Acting Grand Councillor Prince Ying Wang Shou Chun to curb heavy drinking.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the throne admonished Acting Grand Councillor Prince Ying Wang Shou Chun to drink less.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以河中府推官籍阿外權元帥右都監，代領侯小叔軍。

translations.literal: On guichou Hezhong Prefecture push-official Ji A'wai was made acting right marshal overseer to take over Hou Xiaoshu's army.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Ji A'wai, push-official of Hezhong Prefecture, was named acting right marshal overseer to replace Hou Xiaoshu's command.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，上謂宰臣：「人有才堪任事，其心不下者，終不足貴。

translations.literal: On jiayin the emperor told the chief ministers: "When a man has talent fit for office yet his heart is not loyal, in the end he is not worth honoring.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin the emperor told his chief ministers, "A man may have talent enough for office, but if his heart is not loyal he is never worth keeping.

sentences.zh: 」丞相汝礪對曰：「其心不正而濟之以才，所謂虎而翼者也，雖古聖人亦未易知。

translations.literal: " Grand Councillor Rulin replied: "When the heart is crooked and talent is added, that is what they call a tiger given wings — even the ancient sages found such men hard to know.
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Councillor Gao Rulin answered, "A crooked heart joined to talent is a tiger given wings — even the ancient sages could not easily read such men.

sentences.zh: 」上以為然。

translations.literal: " The emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，長春節，免朝。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Long Spring Festival; court audience was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Long Spring Festival, morning audience was excused.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書石盞畏忻為參知政事，兼修國史。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Shizhan Weixin was made Participation Councillor and concurrent National Historian.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Shizhan Weixin joined the council as participation councillor and national historian.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，禁茶。

translations.literal: On xinyou tea was banned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the court banned tea.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔以鳳翔戰功及頒賞等級遍諭諸郡。

translations.literal: On renxu an edict ordered the Fengxiang campaign rewards and graded bounty scales announced in every commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict sent the Fengxiang merit rewards and graded bounty scales to every commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以完顏伯嘉權參知政事，行尚書省於河中府。

translations.literal: On jiazi Wanyan Bojia was made acting Participation Councillor and ran the Masters of Writing at Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Wanyan Bojia was named acting participation councillor and ran the traveling Masters of Writing at Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔職官犯罪非死罪除名，遇赦倖免，有才幹者中外並用。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict ruled that officials guilty of non-capital crimes who were struck from the rolls but spared by amnesty, if capable, might be used inside and outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei an edict allowed officials struck from the rolls for non-capital crimes and spared by amnesty to serve inside or outside the court if they had ability.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉朔，復霍州汾西縣，詔給空名宣敕，遷賞將士之有功者。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guiyou new moon: Huozhou's Fenxi County was recovered; an edict granted blank commission patents to promote soldiers with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on the fourth month's guiyou new moon, Fenxi County in Huozhou was retaken; blank patents were issued to reward meritorious troops.

sentences.zh: 丙子，設京兆南山安撫司。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Jingzhao South Mountain Pacification Office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Jingzhao South Mountain Pacification Office was set up.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，故鳳翔萬戶完顏醜和以死節贈懷遠大將軍，授刺史職。

translations.literal: On dingchou the late Fengxiang Ten-Thousand Household Wanyan Chouhe, for dying loyal, was posthumously made Far-Reaching General and given a prefectural post.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the late Fengxiang ten-thousand household Wanyan Chouhe, for dying loyal, was posthumously made Far-Reaching General with a prefect's commission.

sentences.zh: 其父恕除以功例賞外，遷兩官，升職二等。

translations.literal: His father Shu, beyond the standard merit reward, was advanced two offices and promoted two grades.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shu, beyond the usual merit grant, gained two offices and two ranks.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣官閱河南帥府見兵，籍閑官豪右親丁及遼東、河北客戶為軍。

translations.literal: On jimao officials were sent to review the present troops of the Henan marshalate, register idle officials' wealthy kin and retainers, and enroll clients from Liaodong and Hebei as soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao envoys were sent to muster the Henan marshalate's active troops and enroll idle officials' wealthy kin, retainers, and Liaodong and Hebei clients as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 庚子，募西山獵戶為軍。

translations.literal: On gengzi Western Mountain hunters were recruited as troops.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi hunters of the Western Mountains were drafted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯朔，始造「元光重寶」。

translations.literal: Fifth month, guimao new moon: "Yuanguang Heavy Treasure" was first minted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on the guimao new moon, the court first minted "Yuanguang Heavy Treasure."

sentences.zh: 丙午，復河中府及榮州，遣人持檄招前恆山公武仙。

translations.literal: On bingwu Hezhong Prefecture and Rongzhou were recovered; envoys were sent with proclamations to summon the former Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Hezhong Prefecture and Rongzhou were retaken; envoys with proclamations went to summon the former Duke of Hengshan Wu Xian.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，權平陽公史詠復霍州及洪洞縣。

translations.literal: On yimao Acting Pingyang Duke Shi Yong recovered Huozhou and Hongdong County.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Acting Pingyang Duke Shi Yong retook Huozhou and Hongdong County.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，始造「元光珍貨」，同銀行用。

translations.literal: On dingsi "Yuanguang Precious Goods" was first minted, to circulate alongside silver.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the court first minted "Yuanguang Precious Goods" for circulation with silver.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以檄招東平嚴實。

translations.literal: On wuwu proclamations were sent to summon Yan Shi of Dongping.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu proclamations went out summoning Dongping's Yan Shi.

sentences.zh: 己未，參知政事毅夫言：「脅從人號'忠孝軍'，而置沿淮者所為多不法，請防閑之。

translations.literal: On jiwei Participation Councillor Yifu said: "Coerced followers called the 'Loyal-and-Filial Army,' when posted along the Huai, often act lawlessly — please restrain them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Participation Councillor Pusan Yifu said, "Coerced followers called the 'Loyal-and-Filial Army' posted along the Huai often break the law — they should be restrained.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「人心無常，顧馭之何如耳。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "Hearts are inconstant — it all depends on how one drives them.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Hearts change — everything depends on how you drive them.

sentences.zh: 馭之有術，遠方猶且聽命，況此輩乎！

translations.literal: Drive them with skill and even distant men will obey; how much more these!
translations.idiomatic: Drive them well and even distant men will obey — how much more these!

sentences.zh: 不然，雖左右亦難防閑。

translations.literal: Otherwise even those at your side are hard to restrain.
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise even those beside you are hard to hold in check.

sentences.zh: 正在廓開大度而已。

translations.literal: What matters is only to be broad and magnanimous.
translations.idiomatic: What matters is to stay broad and magnanimous.

sentences.zh: 若是而不能致太平者，命也。

translations.literal: If one does that and still cannot bring peace, it is fate."
translations.idiomatic: If you do that and still cannot win peace, it is fate."

sentences.zh: 」庚申，簽河南路寄居官民充軍。

translations.literal: " On gengshen sojourner households of the Henan Route were enrolled as troops.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengshen sojourner households on the Henan Route were drafted as soldiers.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，徙晉陽公郭文振兵于孟州。

translations.literal: On xinyou Jin'an Duke Guo Wenzhen's troops were moved to Meng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the troops of Jin'an Duke Guo Wenzhen were shifted to Meng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲子，徙權平陽公史詠兵于解州、河中府。

translations.literal: On jiazi Acting Pingyang Duke Shi Yong's troops were moved to Jie Prefecture and Hezhong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the troops of Acting Pingyang Duke Shi Yong were shifted to Jie and Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，京東總帥牙吾塔報淮南之捷。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yihai: Jingdong Commander-in-Chief Hesheli Yawuta reported victory in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, Jingdong Commander-in-Chief Hesheli Yawuta reported victory in Huainan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，罷行省所置監察御史兼彈壓之職。

translations.literal: On dinghai the concurrent suppressor duty of censors attached to the traveling secretariat was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the traveling secretariat's censor suppressor posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 戊子，議遣人招李全、嚴實、張林。

translations.literal: On wuzi it was debated whether to send men to summon Li Quan, Yan Shi, and Zhang Lin.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the court debated envoys to summon Li Quan, Yan Shi, and Zhang Lin.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔罷河中行省，置元帥府。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict abolished the Hezhong traveling secretariat and set up a marshalate.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict abolished the Hezhong traveling secretariat and established a marshalate.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，遙授靜難軍節度使顏盞蝦䗫等以保鳳翔功進官。

translations.literal: On xinchou by remote appointment Jingnan Army Commissioner Yanshan Xiamo and others were advanced for merit in holding Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yanshan Xiamo, remotely appointed Jingnan commissioner, and others were promoted for defending Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅朔，夏人犯積石州，羌界寺族多陷沒，惟桑逋寺僧看逋、昭逋、廝沒及答那寺僧奔鞠等拒而不從。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renyin new moon: Xia forces invaded Jishi Prefecture; many temple-clan settlements on the Qiang frontier were overrun — only Sangbu Temple monks Kanbu, Zhaobu, and Simo and Dana Temple monk Benju among others resisted and would not submit.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on the seventh month's renyin new moon, Xia invaded Jishi; many frontier temple clans fell — only Sangbu Temple's Kanbu, Zhaobu, and Simo and Dana Temple's Benju and others held out and refused submission.

sentences.zh: 詔賞諸僧鈐轄正將等官，而給以廩祿。

translations.literal: An edict rewarded the monks with Controller, Rectifier, and Chief General posts and granted grain salaries.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made the monks controllers, rectifiers, and chief generals and paid them grain salaries.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遣兵守衛解州鹽池。

translations.literal: On yisi troops were sent to guard the Jie Prefecture salt ponds.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi troops were posted to guard Jie Prefecture's salt ponds.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以空名宣敕遷賞諸部降人。

translations.literal: On gengxu blank commission patents were used to advance and reward surrendered tribesmen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu blank patents advanced and rewarded surrendered tribesmen.

sentences.zh: 壬子，除市易用銀及銀與寶泉私相易之禁。

translations.literal: On renzi the ban on market use of silver and on private exchange between silver and treasure notes was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the ban on silver in market trade and on private exchange of silver for treasure notes was removed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，敕諸御史曰：「瑣細事非人主所宜詰，然凡涉奸弊，靡不有關國政者。

translations.literal: On guichou an edict instructed the censors: "Petty matters are not what the sovereign should pursue, yet anything touching corruption invariably bears on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the throne told the censors, "Petty affairs are not for the sovereign to chase, yet whatever touches corruption always bears on government.

sentences.zh: 比聞朝官及承應人月給俸糧，多雜糠土，有司所收曷嘗有是物哉。

translations.literal: Recently it is heard that court officials and attendants' monthly grain stipends are often mixed with chaff and dirt — how could the receiving offices ever accept such goods?
translations.idiomatic: Lately court officials and attendants' monthly grain is said to be laced with chaff and dirt — what receiving office would ever take such stuff?

sentences.zh: 至於出納斗斛，亦小大不一，此皆理所不容者，而台官初不問。

translations.literal: As for the pecks and bushels at issue and receipt, their sizes too are inconsistent — all this reason cannot permit, yet the censorate at first never inquired.
translations.idiomatic: The measuring pecks and bushels at issue and receipt are uneven too — reason forbids it, yet the censorate never asked.

sentences.zh: 事事須朕言之，安用汝曹也！

translations.literal: Everything must wait for me to speak — what use are you people!
translations.idiomatic: Everything waits on me to say it — what good are you?

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，丹鳳門壞。

translations.literal: " On yimao the Vermilion Phoenix Gate collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: " On yimao the Vermilion Phoenix Gate fell in.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，陰坡族之骨鞠門等叛歸夏，元帥夾谷瑞發兵討之，以捷聞。

translations.literal: On dingsi Gumen and others of the Yinpo tribe's Gu Jumen rebelled and went over to Xia; Marshal Jiagu Rui sent troops to suppress them and reported victory.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Gumen and others of the Yinpo Gu Jumen line rebelled and joined Xia; Marshal Jiagu Rui marched against them and reported victory.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞師安石言制敵二事。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Shi Anshi spoke on two matters of controlling the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Shi Anshi addressed two points on controlling the enemy.

sentences.zh: 戊午，宰臣方對次，有司奏前奉御溫敦太平卒。

translations.literal: On wuwu, as chief ministers were in attendance, the authorities reported that former palace attendant Wendun Taiping had died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, while chief ministers were in audience, the offices reported that former palace attendant Wendun Taiping had died.

sentences.zh: 上大駭曰：「朕屢欲授太平一職，每以事阻，今僅授之未數日而亡，豈非天耶！

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly startled and said: "I repeatedly wished to grant Taiping an office, each time blocked by affairs; now I had only just appointed him and within days he died — is this not Heaven's will!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was deeply shaken and said, "Again and again I meant to give Taiping a post, always stopped by business; I had only just named him and within days he was gone — is that not fate?

sentences.zh: 」因謂宰臣曰：「海陵時有護衛二人私語，一曰富貴在天，一曰由君所賜。

translations.literal: " He then told the chief ministers: "In Hailing's time two guards whispered — one said wealth and honor are in Heaven, the other that they come from the ruler's gift.
translations.idiomatic: " He then told the chief ministers, "Under Hailing two guards whispered: one said fortune is in Heaven, the other that it comes from the throne.

sentences.zh: 海陵竊聞之，詔授言由君所得以五品職，意謂誠由己也，而其人以疾竟不及授。

translations.literal: Hailing overheard and ordered that the one who said from the ruler be given a fifth-rank post, meaning to show it truly came from himself — yet the man fell ill and never received the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing overheard and ordered the man who said "from the ruler" given a fifth-rank post, to prove it came from him — but the man fell ill and never took office.

sentences.zh: 章宗秋獵，聞平章張萬公薨，歎曰：'朕乃將拜萬公丞相，而遂不起，命也。

translations.literal: Zhangzong on an autumn hunt heard that Grand Councilor Zhang Wangu had died and sighed: 'I was about to make Wangu chief councilor, yet he could not rise — fate.'
translations.idiomatic: Zhangzong, autumn hunting, heard Grand Councilor Zhang Wangu was dead and sighed, "I was going to make Wangu chief councilor, and he could not rise — fate."

sentences.zh: '」乙丑，詔籍陝西路僑居官民為軍。

translations.literal: " On yichou an edict registered officials and commoners living as refugees in Shaanxi Circuit as military households.
translations.idiomatic: " On yichou an edict enrolled Shaanxi's refugee officials and commoners as military households.

sentences.zh: 八月辛未朔，邳州從宜經略使納合六哥等率都統金山顏俊以沂州百餘人，晨入省署，殺行尚書省蒙古綱，據州反。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinwei new moon: Pizhou flexible-plan commissioner Nahe Liuge and others led overall chief Jinshan Yan Jun with more than a hundred men from Yi Prefecture, entered the provincial offices at dawn, killed Acting Shandong Traveling Secretariat Mongol Gang, and held the prefecture in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on the xinwei new moon, Pizhou flexible-plan commissioner Nahe Liuge and others led overall chief Jinshan Yan Jun with over a hundred Yi Prefecture men into the provincial offices at dawn, killed Acting Shandong Traveling Secretariat Mongol Gang, and seized the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔賞京兆路官軍保全南山諸穀之功，以所全人數多寡為等第，千人以上官一階，三千人以上兩階，五千人以上三階，仍升職一等，能以力戰護之者又增一階，戰沒者就以贈之。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict rewarded the merit of Jingzhao Circuit troops in preserving the southern hills' valleys, grading by numbers preserved: one rank for a thousand or more, two for three thousand, three for five thousand, also one grade in office; those who fought to protect gained another rank; the fallen were posthumously given rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen an edict rewarded Jingzhao troops for saving the southern hills' valleys, by head count: one rank for a thousand or more, two for three thousand, three for five thousand, plus one office grade; those who fought to protect gained another rank; the dead were rewarded posthumously.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣官持空名宣敕，諭以重賞招納合六哥，拒命，即命牙吾塔合行院兵討滅之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an envoy was sent with blank commission edicts, offering heavy rewards to induce Nahe Liuge; on refusal, Yawuta was ordered with traveling secretariat troops to destroy him.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an envoy carried blank commission edicts, promising rich rewards to win Nahe Liuge; if he refused, Yawuta was to join traveling secretariat troops and wipe him out.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，火星入鬼宿中，掩積屍氣。

translations.literal: On yihai Mars entered the Ghost asterism and covered the Heap of Corpses nebula.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Mars entered the Ghost lodge and veiled the Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，詔能捕獲反賊六哥者，除見定官外，仍與世襲謀克。

translations.literal: On yiyou an edict: whoever could capture the rebel Liuge would besides his current rank also receive a hereditary mouke.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou an edict promised that whoever captured the rebel Liuge would keep his present rank and also receive a hereditary mouke.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣官分行蔡、息、陳、亳、唐、鄧、裕諸州，洎司農司州縣吏同議，凡民丁相聚立砦避兵，與各巡檢軍相依者，五十戶以上置砦長一員，百戶增副一員，仍先遷一官，能安民弭盜勸農者論功注授。

translations.literal: On bingxu envoys were dispatched through Cai, Xi, Chen, Bo, Tang, Deng, Yu and other prefectures, with Ministry of Revenue circuit and county clerks to consult: wherever civilian households gathered in stockades to avoid war and relied on local patrol forces, for fifty households or more one stockade chief was set, for a hundred an assistant was added, with prior promotion one rank; those who settled the people, quelled bandits, and urged farming were rewarded by graded merit appointments.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu envoys went through Cai, Xi, Chen, Bo, Tang, Deng, Yu and other prefectures, with Ministry of Revenue clerks, to rule that where civilians banded in stockades against war and leaned on patrol troops, fifty households or more got a stockade chief, a hundred got an assistant, each promoted one rank in advance; those who calmed the people, stopped bandits, and urged farming were appointed by graded merit.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, gengzi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on the gengzi new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 宋人入壽州，女奚烈蒲乃力戰卻之。

translations.literal: Song entered Shou Prefecture; Nüxilie Pu fought hard and drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Song forces entered Shou Prefecture; Nüxilie Pu fought them off.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，樞密院奏提控朮甲剉只罕破宋人之功。

translations.literal: On renyin the Privy Council reported Control Officer Tujia Cuozhihan's merit in defeating Song.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Privy Council reported Control Officer Tujia Cuozhihan's victory over Song.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，宋人攻南陽。

translations.literal: On jiachen Song attacked Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Song attacked Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，牙塔報桃園、淮陽之捷，並以納合六哥結構李全之狀來告。

translations.literal: On bingwu Yata reported victories at Taoyuan and Huaiyang, and also informed that Nahe Liuge had plotted with Li Quan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Yata reported victories at Taoyuan and Huaiyang and said Nahe Liuge had conspired with Li Quan.

sentences.zh: 戊申，降人孫邦佐自李全軍中歸，遙授知東平府兼山東西路兵馬都總管。

translations.literal: On wushen the defector Sun Bangzuo returned from Li Quan's army and was remotely appointed provisional prefect of Dongping and concurrent overall commander of Shandong East and West military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the defector Sun Bangzuo came back from Li Quan's host and was remotely made provisional Dongping prefect and overall commander of Shandong East and West forces.

sentences.zh: 官軍與宋人力戰于胡陂而卻之，提控朮虎春兒為所殺。

translations.literal: Government troops fought Song fiercely at Hubo and repelled them; Control Officer Tuhu Chun'er was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Government troops fought Song hard at Hubo and beat them back; Control Officer Tuhu Chun'er was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，納合六哥所署偽都統烏古論賽漢、夾穀留住等來歸。

translations.literal: On guichou Nahe Liuge's false overall chiefs Wugulun Saihan, Jiagu Liuzhu, and others came over.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Nahe Liuge's false overall chiefs Wugulun Saihan, Jiagu Liuzhu, and others defected.

sentences.zh: 己未，贈朮虎春兒銀青榮祿大夫。

translations.literal: On jiwei Tuhu Chun'er was posthumously granted Silver-Green Glory and Blessings Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Tuhu Chun'er was posthumously made Silver-Green Glory and Blessings Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，紮也胡魯等拔邳州南城。

translations.literal: On bingyin Zhaye Hulu and others took the south city of Pizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Zhaye Hulu and others seized Pizhou's south city.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，權御史中丞帥安石等劾英王守純不實，付有司鞠治，尋詔免罪，而猶責論之。

translations.literal: On dingmao Acting Censor-in-Chief Shi Anshi and others impeached Prince Ying Shou Chun on unsubstantiated charges; he was handed to the authorities for trial, then an edict pardoned him but still held him to blame in discussion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Acting Censor-in-Chief Shi Anshi and others impeached Prince Ying Shou Chun without proof; he was sent for trial, then pardoned by edict but still rebuked in council.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，徙晉陽公郭文振等兵于衛州。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guiyou: the troops of Duke of Jinyang Guo Wenzhen and others were moved to Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month, on guiyou, Duke of Jinyang Guo Wenzhen's troops were shifted to Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，制行樞密院及元帥府，農隙之月分番巡徼校獵，月不過三次。

translations.literal: On yihai regulations for traveling privy council and marshalate: in the agricultural slack months they would rotate frontier patrol and hunting drills, not more than three times a month.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai rules for the traveling privy council and marshalate: in the farming slack months they would rotate patrol and hunt by turns, no more than three times a month.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，上獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On dingchou the emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the emperor hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 己卯，祫於太廟。

translations.literal: On jimao he performed the seasonal offering at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he offered the seasonal rite at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 壬午，火星犯靈台。

translations.literal: On renwu Mars trespassed against the Administrative Platform asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Mars struck the Administrative Platform.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，上獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On yiyou the emperor hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the emperor hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔石壕店、澠池、永寧縣各屯兵千人。

translations.literal: On xinmao an edict garrisoned a thousand troops each at Shihao Station, Mianchi, and Yongning counties.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao an edict posted a thousand troops each at Shihao Station, Mianchi, and Yongning.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，滕州人時明謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On renchen Shi Ming of Teng Prefecture plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Shi Ming of Teng Prefecture plotted revolt and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，唐、鄧行元帥報淮南之捷。

translations.literal: On wuxu the Tang-Deng traveling marshalate reported victory in Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the Tang-Deng traveling marshalate reported a Huainan victory.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，紅襖賊偽監軍徐福等來降。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jihai: Red-Robe bandits' false supervising general Xu Fu and others came to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jihai, Red-Robe bandits' false supervising general Xu Fu and others surrendered.

sentences.zh: 詔進牙吾塔官一階，賜金幣有差。

translations.literal: An edict advanced Yawuta one rank in office and granted gold and coins in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict raised Yawuta one office rank and gave gold and coin rewards in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，總帥牙吾塔報邳州之捷，函叛人六哥首以獻。

translations.literal: On xinchou Commander-in-Chief Yawuta reported victory at Pizhou and presented the rebel Liuge's head in a box.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Commander-in-Chief Yawuta reported victory at Pizhou and sent up the rebel Liuge's head in a casket.

sentences.zh: 開封縣境有虎咥人，詔親軍百人射殺之，賞射獲者銀二十兩，而以內府藥賜傷者。

translations.literal: In Kaifeng County territory a tiger bit people; an edict had a hundred personal guards shoot it dead, rewarded the marksman twenty taels of silver, and gave palace medicines to the wounded.
translations.idiomatic: A tiger in Kaifeng County bit people; an edict sent a hundred personal guards to shoot it, gave the marksman twenty taels of silver, and palace medicine to the wounded.

sentences.zh: 丙午，邳州紅襖賊三千來降，初擬置諸陳、許之間，上以為「若輩雖降，家屬尚在河朔，餘黨必殺之，所得者寡而被害者眾，亦復安忍？

translations.literal: On bingwu three thousand Red-Robe bandits at Pizhou came to surrender; the court at first planned to place them between Chen and Xu; the emperor said, "Though these men surrender, their families are still in Hebei — the remnant bands will surely kill them; the gain is small and the harm great — how can I bear it?
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu three thousand Red-Robe bandits at Pizhou surrendered; the court first meant to settle them between Chen and Xu; the emperor said, "They surrender, but their families are still in Hebei — the rest will kill them; little is gained and many hurt — how can I stomach that?

sentences.zh: 不若命使撫諭，加以官賞而遣之還。

translations.literal: Better to send envoys to reassure them, grant office and reward, and send them home.
translations.idiomatic: Better send envoys to comfort them, give rank and reward, and send them back.

sentences.zh: 果忠於我，雖處河朔豈負我耶？

translations.literal: If they are truly loyal to us, even in Hebei they will not betray us, will they?
translations.idiomatic: If they are truly ours, even in Hebei they will not fail us.

sentences.zh: 且餘眾感恩，將有效順者矣」。

translations.literal: And the rest, grateful, will yet come over in obedience."
translations.idiomatic: The rest, moved by grace, will yet submit."

sentences.zh: 戊午，以上党公完顏開之請，諭開及郭文振、史詠、王遇、張道、盧芝等各與所鄰帥府相視可耕土田，及瀕河北岸之地，分界而種之，以給軍餉。

translations.literal: On wuwu, at Duke of Shangdang Wanyan Kai's request, Kai and Guo Wenzhen, Shi Yong, Wang Yu, Zhang Dao, Lu Zhi, and the rest were told to survey with neighboring marshalates whatever arable land could be worked, and land along the north bank of the Yellow River, divide it, and plant to supply army rations.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, at Duke of Shangdang Wanyan Kai's request, Kai, Guo Wenzhen, Shi Yong, Wang Yu, Zhang Dao, Lu Zhi, and others were told to join neighboring marshalates in surveying workable fields and land along the Yellow River's north bank, divide it, and farm for army grain.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，鞏州行元帥府報會州破夏人之捷。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Gongzhou traveling marshalate reported victory in breaking Xia at Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Gongzhou traveling marshalate reported defeating Xia at Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 十二月己巳朔，徙沿淮巡檢邊軍於內地。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jisi new moon: Huai River patrol frontier troops were moved inland.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the jisi new moon, Huai patrol frontier troops were shifted inland.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以空名宣命金銀符給完顏開賞功。

translations.literal: On guiyou blank commission edicts and gold-silver tallies were given Wanyan Kai to reward merit.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou blank commission edicts and gold-silver tallies were issued to Wanyan Kai for rewarding merit.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，詔延安土人充司縣官義軍使者選人代之，量免其民差稅。

translations.literal: On xinsi an edict had local men of Yan'an fill the posts of circuit and county officials and righteous-army envoys, with commutation of the people's labor levies in proportion.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi an edict put Yan'an locals into circuit and county posts and righteous-army envoy slots, with proportional remission of the people's corvée.

sentences.zh: 邳州民丁死戰陣者各贈官一階。

translations.literal: Pizhou commoners who died in battle were each posthumously granted one rank in office.
translations.idiomatic: Pizhou civilians who died fighting were each posthumously advanced one office rank.

sentences.zh: 歸德、徐、邳、宿、泗、永、亳、潁、壽等州復業及新地民，免差稅二年，見戶一年，嘗供給邳州者復免一年之半，睢州、陳留、杞縣免三之一。

translations.literal: In Guide, Xu, Pizhou, Su, Yong, Bo, Ying, Shou and other prefectures, people returning to old holdings or to new lands were exempt from corvée two years, present households one year; those who had once supplied Pizhou were again exempt half a year; Suizhou, Chenliu, and Qi counties were exempt one-third.
translations.idiomatic: In Guide, Xu, Pizhou, Su, Yong, Bo, Ying, Shou and other prefectures, those returning to old fields or opening new land were exempt from corvée two years, current households one year; those who had once provisioned Pizhou were exempt another half year; Suizhou, Chenliu, and Qi counties one-third.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，上不豫，免朝。

translations.literal: On dinghai the emperor fell ill and court audience was waived.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor was ill and morning audience was excused.

sentences.zh: 戊子，皇太子率百官及王妃、公主入問起居。

translations.literal: On wuzi the crown prince led the hundred officials and the consorts and princesses in to inquire after his health.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the crown prince led officials, consorts, and princesses in to ask after his health.

sentences.zh: 己丑，復入問起居。

translations.literal: On jichou they again came to inquire after his health.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou they came again to ask after his health.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，上崩于寧德殿，壽六十有一。

translations.literal: On gengyin the emperor died in Ningde Hall at the age of sixty-one.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin the emperor died in Ningde Hall, aged sixty-one.

sentences.zh: 上疾大漸，暮夜，近臣皆出，惟前朝資明夫人鄭氏年老侍側，上知其可托，詔之曰：「速召皇太子主後事。

translations.literal: As his illness grew grave, at nightfall the close attendants all withdrew; only Former-Dynasty Worthy-Mind Lady Zheng, old in years, waited at his side; knowing she could be trusted, he instructed her: "Summon the crown prince quickly to take charge of what follows.
translations.idiomatic: As his illness turned critical, at night the close attendants all left; only Former-Dynasty Worthy-Mind Lady Zheng, elderly, stayed by him; knowing she could be trusted, he told her, "Summon the crown prince at once to handle what comes next.

sentences.zh: 」言絕而崩。

translations.literal: " He finished speaking and died.
translations.idiomatic: " He spoke and died.

sentences.zh: 夫人秘之。

translations.literal: The lady kept it secret.
translations.idiomatic: The lady concealed it.

sentences.zh: 是夜，皇后及遣妃龐氏問安寢閣。

translations.literal: That night the empress and the dispatched consort Lady Pang came to the sickroom to ask after him.
translations.idiomatic: That night the empress and dispatched consort Lady Pang came to the sickroom to inquire.

sentences.zh: 龐氏陰狡機慧，常以其子守純年長不得立，心鞅鞅。

translations.literal: Lady Pang was secretly crafty and clever; because her son Shou Chun was older yet could not be heir, her heart was never at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Pang was sly and sharp; her son Shou Chun was older yet could not inherit, and she brooded on it.

sentences.zh: 夫人恐其為變，即紿之曰：「上方更衣，后妃可少休他室。

translations.literal: Fearing she might make trouble, the lady at once deceived her, saying, "His Majesty is changing clothes; consorts may rest awhile in another chamber.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing trouble, the lady deceived her at once: "The emperor is dressing; consorts should wait in another room.

sentences.zh: 」伺其入，遽鑰之，急召大臣，傳遺詔立皇太子，始啟戶出后妃，發喪。

translations.literal: " When they entered she quickly locked the door, urgently summoned the ministers, transmitted the dying edict to install the crown prince, then opened the door and released the consorts, and announced the mourning.
translations.idiomatic: " Once they were inside she bolted the door, hurriedly called the ministers, passed the deathbed edict to install the crown prince, then opened the door and let the consorts out and proclaimed the mourning.

sentences.zh: 皇太子方入宮，英王守純已先入，皇太子知之，分遣樞密院官及東宮親衛軍官移剌蒲阿集軍三萬餘于東華門街。

translations.literal: The crown prince had just entered the palace when Prince Ying Shou Chun had already gone in first; learning of it, the crown prince separately dispatched Privy Council officers and Eastern Palace personal-guard officers Yila Pu'a to gather more than thirty thousand troops on East Flower Gate Street.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince had only just entered the palace when Prince Ying Shou Chun was already inside; told of it, the crown prince sent Privy Council officers and Eastern Palace guard officers Yila Pu'a to mass more than thirty thousand men on East Flower Gate Street.

sentences.zh: 部署即定，命護衛四人監守純於近侍局，乃即皇帝位於柩前。

translations.literal: Once deployment was settled, four guards were ordered to keep Shou Chun under watch in the Close Attendance Bureau; he then took the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: When positions were set, four guards were told to hold Shou Chun in the Close Attendance Bureau; he then took the throne before the bier.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宣遺詔。

translations.literal: On renchen the dying edict was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen the deathbed edict was announced.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔赦中外。

translations.literal: That day an edict amnestied the empire within and without.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict pardoned the realm at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 明年正月戊戌朔，改元正大，諡大行曰繼天興統述道勤仁英武聖孝皇帝，廟號宣宗。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year, on the wuxu new moon, the era name was changed to Zhengda; the late emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor who Continues Heaven, Raises the Lineage, Expounds the Way, Diligent in Benevolence, Heroic in Arms, and Sacred in Filial Piety, with temple name Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: In the new year's first month, on the wuxu new moon, the era became Zhengda; the late sovereign was styled Emperor Continuing Heaven, Raising the Lineage, Expounding the Way, Diligent in Benevolence, Heroic in Arms, Sacred in Filial Piety, temple name Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 三月庚申，葬德陵。

translations.literal: Third month, gengshen: he was buried at De Ling.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengshen, he was buried at De Ling.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：宣宗當金源末運，雖乏撥亂反正之材，而有勵精圖治之志。

translations.literal: Appraisal: Xuanzong stood at the Jin house's late fortune; though he lacked the talent to set chaos right, he had the will to brace himself and govern well.
translations.idiomatic: Appraisal: Xuanzong stood in the Jin dynasty's waning days; though he lacked talent to right chaos, he meant to stir himself and rule well.

sentences.zh: 跡其勤政憂民，中興之業蓋可期也，然而卒無成功者何哉？

translations.literal: Tracing his diligent government and care for the people, a restoration might have been expected — yet why in the end was there no success?
translations.idiomatic: Tracing his earnest rule and care for the people, revival seemed within reach — yet why did he fail in the end?

sentences.zh: 良由性本猜忌，崇信翽御，獎用吏胥，苛刻成風，舉措失當故也。

translations.literal: Truly because his nature was suspicious, he placed excessive trust in inner-chamber attendants, rewarded clerks, harshness became custom, and his measures missed the mark.
translations.idiomatic: Truly his nature was suspicious; he trusted inner attendants too far, favored clerks, harshness became habit, and his acts went wide of the mark.

sentences.zh: 執中元惡，此豈可相者乎，顧乃懷其援立之私，自除廉陛之分，悖禮甚矣。

translations.literal: Zhizhong was the arch villain — how could such a man be made chief councilor? Yet cherishing private gratitude for raising him to the throne, he himself erased the barrier between ruler and minister — the breach of ritual was extreme.
translations.idiomatic: Zhizhong was the chief villain — how could he be chief councilor? Yet clinging to private debt for raising him, he erased the line between throne and minister — ritual was shattered.

sentences.zh: 高琪之誅執中，雖云除惡，律以《春秋》之法，豈逃趙鞅晉陽之責？

translations.literal: Gao Qi's execution of Zhizhong, though called removing evil, judged by the Spring and Autumn standard could not escape Zhao Yang's blame at Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qi's killing of Zhizhong, though called purging evil, by Spring and Autumn law could not escape Zhao Yang's guilt at Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 既不能罪而遂相之，失之又失者也。

translations.literal: That he could not punish him and then made him councilor was error upon error.
translations.idiomatic: That he would not punish him and then made him councilor was mistake piled on mistake.

sentences.zh: 遷汴之後，北顧大元之朝日益隆盛，智識之士孰不先知？

translations.literal: After the move to Bian, looking north the Great Yuan court grew daily more mighty — which man of judgment did not see it first?
translations.idiomatic: After the move to Bian, to the north the Great Yuan court rose day by day — who with judgment did not see it early?

sentences.zh: 方且狃于餘威，牽制群議，南開宋釁，西啟夏侮，兵力既分，功不補患。

translations.literal: Yet he clung to lingering prestige, checked the crowd's counsel, opened Song's quarrel in the south and Xia's insult in the west; strength divided, merit could not repair the harm.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he clung to old might, reined in counsel, opened quarrel with Song in the south and insult from Xia in the west; forces split, gain could not mend the loss.

sentences.zh: 曾未數年，昔也日辟國百里，今也日蹙國裏，其能濟乎？

translations.literal: Within a few years, once the realm widened a hundred li a day — now it shrank a li a day; how could that save it?
translations.idiomatic: Within a few years, where once the realm widened a hundred li a day, now it shrank a li a day — how could that hold?

sentences.zh: 再遷遂至失國，豈不重可歎哉！

translations.literal: Two more moves and the state was lost — how deeply to be lamented!
translations.idiomatic: Two more moves and the state was gone — how bitter to mourn!
